多智能体系统

[MA-0] A Framework for Context Enrichment and Selective Robustness in LLM Social Agents NEURIPS2026

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLM）在社会模拟中因提示（prompt）的语义保持性变化而导致行为显著波动的问题，即模型行为的脆弱性（brittleness），这给社会模拟结果的可验证性带来了挑战。其核心解决方案在于提出一种可控的上下文增强（controlled context enrichment）框架，通过一系列系统化的提示替换规则，分别对中性填充、通用社会背景、描述性决策依据以及规范性决策依据等不同类型的上下文进行结构化增强。同时，为评估增强效果，引入“选择性鲁棒性”（selective robustness）作为验证标准，要求模型对语义不变的提示变化保持不敏感，但对与决策相关社会环境的变化具有方向性响应。研究通过类囚徒困境的游戏场景验证该框架，发现不同形式的上下文增强会引发模型产生差异化的、可区分的行为模式，且其效果在不同模型间存在显著差异，从而为提升LLM代理在社会模拟中的稳健性提供了可操作的路径与评估方法。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06914
作者: Mattia Greiche,Reihaneh Rabbany,Maximilian Puelma Touzel
机构: McGill University (麦吉尔大学); Mila - Quebec Artificial Intelligence Institute (魁北克人工智能研究所)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: Accepted to the SocialAgent Workshop @ NeurIPS 2026. 12 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Researchers use large language models as agents in social simulations, where agents are prompted with observations and background information intended to shape their actions. Yet LLM agents have been shown to substantially change their behavior under meaning-preserving prompt variations, creating a validation problem for social simulation. One plausible hypothesis is that this brittleness reflects a lack of grounding and can be reduced by enriching the context provided to the agents. Whether richer context improves robustness remains unclear, in part because context richness and robustness are rarely defined in ways that support controlled comparisons. We address the first need with controlled context enrichment, a set of prompt substitution rules that systematically enriches distinct types of context: neutral padding, generic social background, descriptive decision grounding, and normative decision grounding. We address the second by introducing selective robustness as a validation criterion: insensitivity to meaning-preserving prompt variation combined with a directional response to decision-relevant changes in the social world. We demonstrate the framework in a Prisoner’s Dilemma-like game, showing how it can be used to identify which forms of context enrichment produce more desirable and robust agent behavior. We find that these forms of enrichment produce distinct behavioral patterns that vary between the two models tested.

[MA-1] Airlock: Bounding the Multi-Agent Blast Radius via Selective Online Containment

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体系统（multi-agent systems）在执行任务过程中，因单个智能体输出故障而引发的故障扩散问题。传统方案中，单智能体防护机制局限于局部控制，而现有跨智能体管控策略要么仅隔离故障源而忽略下游受影响的消费者，要么采取全局回滚，导致正常任务流程被无谓中断。其核心解决方案在于提出Airlock框架，通过树状结构运行时系统EdgeCitadel实现垂直权限收缩，建立智能体节点间的边界与控制开关；同时采用追加式不可变溯源有向无环图（append-only provenance DAG）记录跨智能体的数据消费关系。当触发警报后，Airlock可沿溯源图正向追踪污染传播路径以定位受感染执行和待执行操作，并反向追溯根本原因。在控制开关处，系统提供双层处置策略：默认全隔离层（full quarantine tier）冻结受影响分支，无需求解器；优化剪枝层（assured optimized cut tier）则采用“设篱-修剪”（fence-then-prune）机制，在满足时限约束的前提下实现最小化破坏的最优割集。实验表明，在1,832次测试床运行、161次真实智能家居大语言模型（LLM）部署及24,266条仿真记录中，Airlock实现了主测试平台与智能家居网格上所有警报后故障动作的零漏过阻断，且相较A2A与LangGraph原生控制，保留健康工作量提升68至96个百分点，优化剪枝策略在高传播密度场景下比全隔离策略多保留46个百分点的正常工作，验证了运行时权限边界与在线溯源协同设计在实现精准故障隔离的同时，有效避免对正常任务的过度影响。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06727
作者: Zhonghao Zhan,Javad Forough,Yefan Zhang,Krinos Li,Xiao Ma,Hamed Haddadi
机构: 未知
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:When multi-agent systems act on the external world, a single agent’s faulty output can spread across tasks before detection, creating a system-wide blast radius. Single-agent guardrails are confined to individual harnesses, while existing multi-agent controls either cancel only the faulty source and miss downstream consumers or halt and roll back the entire workflow at the cost of healthy work. We present Airlock, a multi-agent runtime and guardrail for selective post-alert fault containment. Its tree-structured runtime, EdgeCitadel, narrows permissions vertically from parent to child agents to establish node boundaries and control switches. Meanwhile, an append-only provenance DAG records cross-agent data consumption horizontally. Upon an alert, Airlock traces forward on this DAG to isolate tainted executions and pending actions, and backward to narrow root causes. At the site switches, a default full quarantine tier freezes affected branches without a solver, while an assured optimized cut tier uses fence-then-prune to enforce a deadline-aware minimum cut minimizing collateral disruption. Across 1,832 testbed runs, 161 physical smart-home LLM runs, and 24,266 simulation records, Airlock blocks all post-alert faulty actuations on our main testbed and smart-home grids with zero post-convergence leaks. Whereas native controls in A2A and LangGraph either contain at most 33.3% of faults or retain at most 16% of work without redo, Airlock retains +68 pp to +96 pp more healthy work, and its optimized cut retains +46 pp more than full quarantine under dense spread. These results show that co-designing runtime authority boundaries with online provenance enables surgical fault containment without sacrificing healthy work (code: this https URL).

[MA-2] Signed Sealed Leaked: Trust Beyond Signature for MCP Toolchains

【速读】：该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）代理在依赖第三方工具（如 Model Context Protocol, MCP）时所面临的信任安全问题：即使工具经过合法签名，仍可能在执行其宣称功能的同时隐藏恶意代码，导致敏感信息泄露。现有运行时防御机制（如 Meta 的 MCPGuard-Dynamic）虽能阻止直接的数据外泄，但无法防范通过合法请求路径隐含泄露的攻击。论文提出“胚系执行”（germline execution）作为核心解决方案，其关键在于通过为每次工具调用创建从无数据状态的胚系进程（germline process）派生的临时副本，确保每个副本仅接收其目标所授权的数据，从而实现信息隔离。由于恶意代码只能访问其副本中的有限数据，其可泄露的信息被严格限制。在假设副本隔离与胚系进程无数据的前提下，论文形式化证明了对所有已签名版本的接收端非干扰性（sink noninterference），并对确定性执行版本引入可验证的见证机制以检测数据流违规。实验表明，在153次攻击测试中，胚系执行未发现任何未经授权的数据披露，而基线防御和消融实验则存在5.9%至74.5%的泄露率；同时，单个副本支持的调用延迟仅为10-49毫秒，相较传统每调用一次重启工具的方式快2至28倍。结果表明，基于数据隔离的执行模型可有效防御嵌入于认证软件中的隐蔽恶意代码。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06585
作者: Yichiet Aun(Universiti Tunku Abdul Rahman),Mohammed A. Alhartomi(University of Tabuk),Jing Jie Tan(National University of Singapore),Waqas Nadeem(Universiti Tunku Abdul Rahman),Adeb Salh(Universiti Tunku Abdul Rahman),Shankar Karuppayah(Bitranger, CYRES, Universiti Sains Malaysia),Sin Chee Tan(ABLEs)
机构: Universiti Tunku Abdul Rahman(拉曼大学学院); University of Tabuk(塔布克大学); National University of Singapore(新加坡国立大学); Bitranger; Universiti Sains Malaysia(马来西亚理科大学); ABLEs
类目: Cryptography and Security (cs.CR); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 24 pages, 5 figures, 15 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:AI agents rely on third-party tools, such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, whose publishers can be authenticated and whose execution can be restricted by runtime security policies. Yet authenticity does not guarantee benign behaviour: a legitimately signed tool may perform its advertised function while concealing malicious code that leaks confidential information. We demonstrate this trust failure with a signed MCP tool that embeds sensitive data in requests to a policy-allowed destination. Meta’s MCPGuard-Dynamic, a state-of-the-art runtime defence, blocks a direct exfiltration attempt in the same run, yet fails to prevent this attack in every trial. We introduce germline execution, which limits information disclosure without inspecting or trusting tool implementations. Each tool invocation runs in ephemeral copies forked from a data-free germline process, each receiving only information authorised for its destination. Even if malicious code executes, what it can disclose is bounded by the data available to its copy. Under explicit assumptions on copy confinement and a data-free germline, we prove sink noninterference for every signed release and, for releases deterministic within our replay model, show that a verified witness establishes a flow violation. Across 153 attack runs, no unauthorised disclosure was detected under germline execution, compared with 5.9-74.5% of runs under baseline defences and an ablation. Invocations served by a single copy completed in 10-49 ms, 2-28x faster than restarting the tool for every invocation, the conventional way to clear state. These results show that data-isolated execution protects agent toolchains against malicious code concealed within authenticated software.

[MA-3] Corralling AI Risks with Grassroots Contracts

【速读】：该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）快速发展背景下，数字平台所面临的三大核心风险：一是全球性社会与经济平台被 AI 所控制，导致人类整体陷入对 AI 的依赖与脆弱性；二是匿名运行的不可问责 AI 代理在平台中与人类并行存在，可能伪装成人类、服务于未知目标且不受任何约束；三是由匿名 AI 生成的无法溯源的深度伪造内容（deepfakes），使真实信息难以辨识，且生产者逃避责任。其解决方案的关键在于提出“草根合同”（grassroots contracts）这一新型机制，作为对法国思想家皮埃尔-约瑟夫·普鲁东（Pierre-Joseph Proudhon）百年契约理念的数字重构，通过在社交图谱中引入可追溯的可信身份与行为记录，以及在社交网络中实现内容数字溯源，构建具有问责能力的 AI 代理体系与真实内容验证机制。研究进一步开发了可运行的智能手机应用原型，验证了该方案在遏制上述三类重大 AI 风险方面的可行性与有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06374
作者: Ehud Shapiro
机构: London School of Economics (伦敦政治经济学院); Weizmann Institute of Science (魏茨曼科学研究所)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Distributed, Parallel, and Cluster Computing (cs.DC); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:AI’s inflection point is a fountain of alarming risks. Digital platforms in particular are vulnerable to three major AI risks, as those in control of global platforms cede control to AI, of the algorithms, of membership and of content: (1) AI control of global platforms, social and economic, used by the majority of humanity, resulting in the majority of humanity becoming vulnerable to AI control. (2) Unaccountable AI agents operating anonymously on social and economic digital platforms, side-by-side with humans, possibly masquerading as humans, serving unknown masters with unknown goals, operating under unknown restraints without accountability or culpability. (3) Unattributed deepfakes generated by anonymous AI, with people unable to distinguish them from genuine content and with their producers evading accountability and culpability. Here, we propose to corral these AI risks with grassroots contracts, a digital incarnation of a two-centuries old notion of Pierre-Joseph Proudhon. We present grassroots contracts for a social graph with accountable AI agents and for a social network with digital provenance, and working smartphone apps that implement the two and show how they corral these major AI risks: (1) AI control of global platforms. (2) Unaccountable AI agents. (3) Unattributed deepfakes. Subjects: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Distributed, Parallel, and Cluster Computing (cs.DC); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA) Cite as: arXiv:2611.06374 [cs.AI] (or arXiv:2611.06374v1 [cs.AI] for this version) https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2611.06374 Focus to learn more arXiv-issued DOI via DataCite (pending registration)

[MA-4] Mechanical Engineering Skills: An Open Library of Agent Skills for Design Analysis and Manufacturing

【速读】：该论文旨在解决机械工程领域中专业工具（如计算机辅助设计、仿真、制造和研究工具）分散、接口各异且学习成本高的问题。其核心挑战在于如何将这些高度专业化、异构化的技能整合为一个统一、可交互的智能系统，使工程师能够通过自然语言或语音指令即可调用复杂工程能力。解决方案的关键在于提出“机械工程技能库”（Mechanical Engineering Skills），这是一个开源的33项代理技能集合，每项技能均包含操作指令、可执行工具与验证流程，实现了从自然语言请求到精确工程计算的端到端自动化。系统通过语言模型解析用户意图并协调技能调度，而确定性工具负责执行计算并返回经过验证的结果，从而确保可复现性和准确性。该方法无需针对特定工具进行界面培训、本地模型部署或微调，所有技能可按需加载，仅需一条命令即可安装。其中19项技能基于实验室已发表或预印本研究成果实现，涵盖文本生成CAD、连杆机构综合、计算流体动力学（CFD）设置、应力场与晶格代理模型、方程发现、增材制造规划及过程监控等前沿功能；其余14项支持通用工程与教育需求。论文还提出了技能格式规范、设计原则以及将科研成果转化为实用工作流的方法。五项案例研究在明确证据范围下独立重演，验证了晶格均质化分析的精确一致性、火箭顶点高度预测误差低于4%（对比OpenRocket基准）、方程拟合精度比三次多项式高九倍（在未见温度点），以及孔隙度监测的全流程端到端模拟。尽管受控的代理比较尚待后续研究，但该开放库已公开发布，为工程智能化提供了一种可扩展、可验证的范式。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05758
作者: Achuth Chandrasekhar,Jesse Barkley,Peter Pak,Rumi Loghmani,Aakash Oza,Amir Barati Farimani
机构: Carnegie Mellon University (卡内基梅隆大学)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Mechanical engineers use specialized tools for CAD, simulation, manufacturing and research, each with a distinct interface and learning curve. We present Mechanical Engineering Skills, an open library of 33 agent skills that makes these capabilities accessible through a single text or voice conversation. Each skill combines operating instructions, executable tools and verification procedures. A language model interprets the request, selects and coordinates skills, while deterministic tools perform computations and return checked results. Default workflows require no tool-specific interface training, local model execution or model fine-tuning; skills load on demand and install with one command. Nineteen skills adapt published or preprint research from our laboratory, including text-to-CAD, linkage synthesis, CFD setup, stress-field and lattice surrogates, equation discovery, additive-manufacturing planning and in-process monitoring. Fourteen additional skills support core engineering and education. We describe the skill format, design principles and a method for translating research into practical workflows. Five case studies with explicit evidence scopes and independent reruns demonstrate exact analytical agreement for lattice homogenization, rocket apogee predictions within 4% of stored OpenRocket references, an equation fit nine times more accurate than a cubic polynomial at an unseen temperature, and an end-to-end rehearsal of porosity monitoring. Controlled agent comparisons remain future work. The open library is available at this https URL.

[MA-5] Same Method Different Task: What the Bitter Lesson Does Not License in Social Simulation NEURIPS2026

【速读】：该论文试图解决的问题是：在基于大语言模型（LLM）的社会模拟中，尽管生成式人工智能（Generative AI）遵循“苦涩的教训”（bitter lesson），即通过计算规模扩展的通用方法优于手工编码的领域知识，但现有研究中出现的若干反直觉现象——如过早出现的合作行为、群体共识却缺乏个体一致性、种群同质化等——无法仅通过计算规模或模型结构解释。其核心问题在于，当前社会模拟往往将代理（agent）视为孤立的文本预测器，忽略了真实社会互动中的利益相关性与后果机制。解决方案的关键在于引入“利害关系”（stakes）这一缺失要素：真正的社会行为（如合作、背叛、规范执行）本质上是利益相关方在相互影响下产生的结果，而非无偏观察者对文本的预测。论文通过一个包含540个代理的初步实验验证，当代理被赋予持久后果而非单纯追求合作时，策略会因模型家族不同而发生显著重构，但始终未能产生人类般的多样性。因此，作者主张应构建混合动机（mixed-motive）环境来塑造代理，而非仅以测试为目的；并提出应重新考虑代理的预训练方式，使其具备社会行为演化所需的情境敏感性与后果感知能力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05717
作者: Justin Downes,Robby Milletich,Newel Hirst
机构: Amazon Web Services(亚马逊网络服务)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: Accepted at the SocialAgent Workshop, NeurIPS 2026 (non-archival). 15 pages, 5 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The bitter lesson holds that general methods leveraging computation defeat hand-encoded domain knowledge. We argue it carries a condition its popular reading omits: in every case Sutton cites, the general method was scaled against the same task the domain engineering was solving. Social simulation substituted across tasks instead, replacing hand-built agents with an artifact optimized for predicting text. The move is bitter-lesson-shaped, but the lesson does not license it. Prediction is a solitary act: the predictor bears no consequences from the interaction it models. Cooperation, defection, and norm enforcement are phenomena of interested parties; they do not exist for a disinterested observer at any scale. What is missing is not emergence, which LLM populations already show, but stakes. We show that several anomalies reported in prior work (excess cooperation that predates alignment training, collective agreement without individual fidelity, and population homogeneity) follow from this account. A 540-agent pilot with pre-specified hypotheses, which tests sensitivity to persistent consequences rather than cooperation, finds that consequences reshape strategies in two of three model families but never produce human-like heterogeneity. We argue for mixed-motive settings that shape agents rather than only test them, and ask whether agents should be pretrained differently from predictors.

[MA-6] MA-SafeDiffuser: Safe Multi-Agent Planning with Diffusion Probabilistic Models AAMAS2026

Abstract:We propose MA-SafeDiffuser, a multi-agent extension of SafeDiffuser that equips diffusion-based trajectory planners with finite-time diffusion invariance guarantees for joint-agent safety specifications. Building on the single-agent construction that embeds control barrier function (CBF) constraints into reverse-diffusion updates, we: (i) formalize joint safe sets as intersections of per-agent and pairwise barrier sets; (ii) derive centralized and decentralized (communication-aware) constrained denoising procedures with provable invariance under mild assumptions; (iii) address local-trap and deadlock phenomena via time-varying specifications and liveness CBFs; and (iv) develop a lightweight benchmarking suite including a multi-agent Maze2D domain. Empirically, MA-SafeDiffuser reduces violation counts relative to unconstrained diffusion baselines, while retaining planning quality. We provide algorithms, proofs, and reference implementations.

【速读】：该论文旨在解决生成式 AI (Generative AI) 系统在边缘或云环境中执行时面临的资源调度不确定性问题。这类系统基于大语言模型（LLMs）构建，以自主多步流水线形式运行，动态调用工具、将观测结果融入记忆并迭代求解任务，其整体计算量、带宽需求及端到端延迟在调度时刻不可预知——这些指标由运行时的中间观测和随机词元采样动态决定，表现为重尾、多模态的随机变量。这种不可预测性导致基础设施编排器陷入两难：资源不足可能引发执行中限流与超时，而过度预留则浪费稀缺的边缘或云端资源。现有调度器依赖已知的固定流水线图结构，而边缘资源管理方法通常采用参数化或平稳的需求模型，均无法适应生成式流水线的未知且非平稳特性。为此，论文提出将该场景形式化为不确定性感知的生成式编排问题，目标是在调度时刻预先分配足够的计算与带宽资源，以在指定概率下覆盖实际需求，并验证任务可满足截止时间约束。解决方案的关键是提出置信预留编排算法（Conformal Reservation for Orchestration, CRO），该算法通过滑动窗口内的历史执行轨迹，利用分位数预测（conformal prediction） 技术，在无需假设分布的前提下，实现有限样本、无分布依赖的覆盖率保证。仿真结果表明，CRO 是唯一在所有风险水平下均能同时满足目标覆盖率的算法，且在满足覆盖率的方案中实现最低的过预留，资源浪费约为基于切比雪夫界基线方法的一半。

类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Distributed, Parallel, and Cluster Computing (cs.DC); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Networking and Internet Architecture (cs.NI)
备注: 6 pages, 2 figures. Accepted to IEEE MECOM 2026, Marrakech, Morocco, 2-4 November 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) systems powered by large language models (LLMs) execute as autonomous multi-step pipelines that dynamically invoke tools, integrate observations into memory, and iterate until a task is resolved or a resource budget is exhausted. Unlike classical workflows with fixed graphs, the aggregate compute, bandwidth, and end-to-end latency demands of such pipelines are unknown at dispatch time: they emerge at runtime from intermediate observations and stochastic token sampling, yielding heavy-tailed, multi-modal random variables. This unpredictability forces infrastructure orchestrators into a dilemma: under-provisioning risks mid-execution throttling and deadline violations, while over-provisioning wastes scarce edge or cloud capacity. Existing schedulers require a fully known pipeline graph, while edge resource-management methods rely on parametric or stationary demand models, and neither fits the unknown, non-stationary profiles of agentic pipelines. We formalize this setting as the uncertainty-aware agentic orchestration problem, where the goal is to reserve, at dispatch time, compute and bandwidth allocations that cover actual pipeline demands, and to verify that the pipeline can meet its deadline, each with a prescribed probability. We then propose Conformal Reservation for Orchestration (CRO), an online algorithm that translates a sliding window of past execution traces into dispatch-time resource allocations with finite-sample, distribution-free coverage guarantees via conformal prediction. Simulations over heterogeneous task mixes with multi-modal and heavy-tailed profiles show that CRO is the only evaluated method that simultaneously satisfies target probabilistic coverage across all risk levels while, among coverage-feasible methods, attaining the lowest over-reservation, roughly halving the resource waste of the Chebyshev-bound baseline.

Abstract:Multi-agent language-model systems often add a reviewer to improve an upstream agent’s decision. Yet a reviewer can both repair errors and replace decisions that were already correct. We study this as a problem of institutional jurisdiction: conditional on the same proposal, task information, model, and review output, when is the reviewer authorized to make its recommendation binding? We compare broad override authority with an evidence gate that permits replacement only after the reviewer produces a mechanically valid record of a binding-constraint violation and a compliant repair. Across two locally run open-weight models, 96 spatial-policy tasks, and a 96-task portfolio-transfer benchmark, the gate sharply reduces corruption of correct proposals while retaining most repairs of violations. The directions of this tradeoff are partly implied by the rule; its magnitude depends on reviewer transitions and upstream proposal states. A prospective validation then gives the reviewer an explicit choice to retain, replace, or escalate. This eliminates correct-proposal corruption for Qwen, but Mistral still replaces all 48 correct proposals; Qwen also declines every welfare-only repair that Mistral frequently attempts. Thus interface design changes reviewer behavior but is not a model-independent safeguard. The result is not that restricted review is universally better. It is that reviewer competence, action interface, and binding jurisdiction jointly determine both the correction domain and the corruption surface.

[MA-9] Soft-Label Governance for Distributional Safety in Multi-Agent Systems

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体人工智能系统中涌现的复杂风险问题，即单个智能体在孤立状态下不会产生，但在协作或交互过程中可能引发的系统性安全风险。现有安全评估框架依赖于二元分类（如“安全”/“不安全”），忽略了基于代理（proxy-based）评估中的不确定性，从而导致对真实风险的误判。为此，本文提出SWARM（System-Wide Assessment of Risk in Multi-agent systems）仿真框架，其核心创新在于用软概率标签 $ p = P(v=+1) \in [0,1] $ 替代传统的二元标签，实现连续值收益计算、毒性度量与治理干预的精细化建模。该框架配备模块化治理引擎，可配置多种调控机制（如交易税、熔断机制、声誉衰减和随机审计），并通过概率性指标（如期望毒性 E[1−p∣accepted]\mathbb{E}[1-p \mid \text{accepted}]E[1−p∣accepted] 与质量差距 E[p∣accepted]−E[p∣rejected]\mathbb{E}[p \mid \text{accepted}] - \mathbb{E}[p \mid \text{rejected}]E[p∣accepted]−E[p∣rejected]）量化治理效果。实验表明，严格的治理虽未提升安全性，却使福利水平下降超40%；而过度内部化外部性会导致系统总福利从基准+262骤降至-67，毒性水平却保持不变。熔断机制需精细校准：阈值过严会严重损害系统价值，而最优阈值可在适度福利与最低毒性间取得平衡。配套实验进一步验证了软度量能有效识别自优化智能体对传统二元评估的代理博弈行为。该基础治理层可直接应用于实时大语言模型驱动的智能体（如Concordia实体、Claude、GPT-4o Mini），无需修改。研究结果表明，实现分布式的系统安全必须依赖连续的风险度量，且治理杠杆的校准本质上涉及可量化的安全-福利权衡。源代码与项目资源已公开。

Abstract:Multi-agent AI systems exhibit emergent risks that no single agent produces in isolation. Existing safety frameworks rely on binary classifications of agent behavior, discarding the uncertainty inherent in proxy-based evaluation. We introduce SWARM (\textbfSystem-\textbfWide \textbfAssessment of \textbfRisk in \textbfMulti-agent systems), a simulation framework that replaces binary good/bad labels with \emphsoft probabilistic labels p = P(v=+1) \in [0,1] , enabling continuous-valued payoff computation, toxicity measurement, and governance intervention. SWARM implements a modular governance engine with configurable levers (transaction taxes, circuit breakers, reputation decay, and random audits) and quantifies their effects through probabilistic metrics including expected toxicity \mathbbE[1-p \mid \textaccepted] and quality gap \mathbbE[p \mid \textaccepted] - \mathbbE[p \mid \textrejected] . Across seven scenarios with five-seed replication, strict governance reduces welfare by over 40% without improving safety. In parallel, aggressively internalizing system externalities collapses total welfare from a baseline of +262 down to -67 , while toxicity remains invariant. Circuit breakers require careful calibration; overly restrictive thresholds severely diminish system value, whereas an optimal threshold balances moderate welfare with minimized toxicity. Companion experiments show soft metrics detect proxy gaming by self-optimizing agents passing conventional binary evaluations. This basic governance layer applies to live LLM-backed agents (Concordia entities, Claude, GPT-4o Mini) without modification. Results show distributional safety requires \emphcontinuous risk metrics and governance lever calibration involves quantifiable safety-welfare tradeoffs. Source code and project resources are publicly available at this https URL.

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Decision Models (DMs), a new class of AI models, give fast responses and return a probability distribution over a fixed set of options. These properties make them candidate human surrogates in economic simulations and surveys, a role increasingly filled by Large Language Models (LLMs), which are costly at scale and under-represent the variation in human behaviour. We present a first evaluation of DMs as human surrogates in economics, comparing 10 DMs with 8 LLMs in three economic settings: a household spending survey on consumption, several classic economic games and a labour-market field experiment. Frontier DMs, those that score highest on general decision-making benchmarks, reproduce the variation in human responses more closely than LLMs in all three settings. They capture the modal human response as well as LLMs in the spending survey, but less well in the economic games. Frontier DMs are also roughly ten times faster than the fastest LLM and can be over a hundred times cheaper. Together, these results suggest that DMs capture the heterogeneity of human behaviour better than LLMs and make large-scale economic simulations more feasible.

[NLP-0] SpecCompact: Accelerating LLM Agent Context Compaction with Slot-Parallel Semantic Speculative Verification

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）智能体在处理持续增长的交互历史时，因使用大型模型进行上下文压缩而导致显著延迟的问题。核心挑战在于如何在保持信息完整性与降低延迟之间实现有效平衡。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种名为SpecCompact的框架，通过槽位并行语义推测（slot-parallel semantic speculation） 实现压缩加速。具体而言，SpecCompact微调一个小型草稿模型（drafter），并行生成结构化摘要槽位（structured summary slots），由目标模型对每个槽位进行验证与修复，同时后续生成基于更新后的槽位前缀进行。该方法结合系统级优化，减少重复的上下文处理和模型调用。实验结果表明，在AppWorld和τ³基准测试中，相较于传统的Hermes式摘要方法，SpecCompact实现了2.04–5.63倍的压缩速度提升；用户研究进一步显示，在Hermes系统内实现8.68倍的中位压缩速度提升，验证了其高效性与实用性。

Abstract:LLM agents use context compaction to manage growing interaction histories, but summarizing long histories with large models can introduce substantial delays. Compaction therefore requires balancing information retention against latency. We observe that structured summary slots can retain information when generated independently. Based on this observation, we present SpecCompact, a framework that accelerates compaction through slot-parallel semantic speculation. SpecCompact fine-tunes a small drafter and generates slots in parallel. The target model verifies each proposed line and repairs rejected content, while subsequent drafting uses the updated slot prefix. System optimizations further reduce repeated context processing and model calls. Across AppWorld and \tau^3 benchmarks with two target models, SpecCompact achieves 2.04 – 5.63\times compaction speedups over Hermes-style summarization. Separate downstream evaluations reveal model- and task-dependent performance trade-offs. A user study within Hermes further shows an 8.68\times median compaction speedup.

[NLP-1] LongBanana: An Expert-Verified Benchmark for Long-Context Multi-Reference Image Synthesis NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在代理驱动的图像生成时代，长上下文多参考图像合成任务中缺乏权威评估基准的问题。具体而言，该任务要求系统从分散的视觉证据中检索相关信息、排除干扰项、准确绑定实体与关系，并基于多个参考图像生成一张语义连贯的最终图像。其解决方案的关键在于提出LongBanana——首个由专家设计并验证的长上下文多参考图像合成基准，包含90个精心设计的任务，采用3×3分类体系，每个任务配备约32张参考图像、20个约束条件和50个评估项，共计4,670项专家指定的原子级评估指标。该基准采用图结构引导的评估设计，将实体-关系图中的节点、边及整体图结构的义务转化为内容保真度（Content Fidelity）、关系绑定（Relational Binding）和全局约束满足度（Global Constraint Satisfaction）三类检查清单项，实现可审计的量化评估。此外，论文还引入LongBanana-Gen框架，通过代理调度机制支持长周期图像生成，实验表明最小化代理调度即可提升生成效果，而基于ReAct-Plan-Exec-Reflect（RPR）的工作流则通过强化证据锚定与自我修正能力，实现依赖于代理架构的性能增益。总体而言，LongBanana为衡量密集视觉证据利用能力提供了可复现的测试平台，并成为推动更强代理驱动图像生成系统发展的共同目标。

Abstract:We introduce LongBanana, to our knowledge the first expert-designed and expert-verified benchmark for long-context multi-reference image synthesis in the age of agent-driven image generation. The task requires retrieving dispersed visual evidence, rejecting distractors, binding entities and relations, and composing one coherent final image from multiple references. LongBanana contains 90 carefully designed tasks organized by a 3-by-3 taxonomy; each task includes about 32 reference images, 20 constraints, and 50 evaluation items, yielding 4,670 expert-specified atomic evaluation items in total. Its graph-grounded evaluation design instantiates each task with reference images and an entity-relation graph, then converts node, edge, and whole-graph obligations into checklist items for Content Fidelity, Relational Binding, and Global Constraint Satisfaction. Reviewed expert labels include a 15% double-labeled subset with 89.4% exact agreement and 0.83 quadratic weighted kappa. We further introduce LongBanana-Gen, an agent-harness framework for long-horizon image generation; experiments show that minimal agent harnesses improve over direct generation, while a ReAct-Plan-Exec-Reflect (RPR) workflow yields harness-dependent gains by strengthening evidence grounding and repair. Together, LongBanana provides an auditable testbed for measuring dense visual evidence use and a shared target for developing stronger agent-driven image-generation systems. Code and data are available at the project page: this https URL.

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前大型语言模型（LLM）特征监测方法在动态上下文环境下失效的问题，特别是当模型因提示（prompting）而采用不同政治立场“人格”（persona）时，其潜在表示空间的几何结构是否发生系统性变化。传统监测方法如线性探针和稀疏自编码器（Sparse Autoencoders, SAEs）通常假设特征表示具有上下文不变性，但本文发现，当模型被引导至自由派或保守派人格时，其隐层空间中词向量在语义轴上的投影以及语义轴之间的相对对齐关系会呈现出与指定意识形态一致的系统性重构。这一表征重组织显著影响了对安全相关特征（如真实性与道德性）的评估：基于无人格训练的线性探针、SAE分类器及人工选取词表示构建的分类器，在应用于人格化模型时产生明显偏倚的评分结果。因此，该研究的关键发现是，模型内部表示的几何关系并非静态固定，而是受人格条件调节，这揭示了现有特征监测范式在动态人格情境下的局限性，进而挑战了基于静态表示进行模型安全监控的有效性。

作者: Austin C. Kozlowski,Avital Mintz,Madison Lee
机构: Knowledge Lab; University of Chicago (芝加哥大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 26 pages, 14 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Common methods for monitoring features in large language models (LLMs) such as linear probes and sparse autoencoders (SAEs) assume that features maintain a consistent representation across contexts. LLMs, however, can flexibly adopt different perspectives or “personas” that suggest different underlying systems of conceptual relations. In this paper, we examine whether prompting an LLM to adopt a persona alters the representational geometry of the model’s latent space. We extract representations of over 9,000 common words and 33 semantic axes from models adopting liberal and conservative political personas and compare these against two neutral baselines. We find that persona conditioning systematically alters both the projections of words onto semantic axes and the alignments among the axes themselves in directions consistent with the specified ideology. We then test the implications of this reorganization for two safety-relevant features: truthfulness and morality. Linear probes, SAE-based classifiers, and classifiers built from manually selected word representations, all trained without a persona, produce divergent results when applied to models conditioned on political personas, producing politically slanted ratings of truth and morality on controversial statements. These findings suggest that internal representations, as they are conventionally extracted, can exhibit different geometric relations when the model adopts personas, potentially undermining monitoring efforts.

[NLP-3] Before You Continue: Evaluating Time-Sensitive Safety Awareness in Conversational Assistants

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）在处理涉及时间依赖性约束的对话请求时，未能有效识别并应用这些约束的问题。具体而言，当用户在后续交互中未明确提及先前设定的时间限制时，助手往往无法自动推断或适配这些隐含的时间约束，从而导致给出不安全或不合逻辑的建议。其解决方案的关键在于构建一个名为TASC（Temporal Action Safety in Conversation）的基准测试框架，用于评估模型在对话中对时间依赖性约束的应用能力。TASC包含3,418个基于128个模板生成的输入，并额外设计了33个情景以区分模型在计算经过时间与实际应用该信息之间的表现差异。实验结果表明，尽管多数模型能够正确计算时间间隔，但在需根据时间约束调整建议的场景中，仅有30.5%的情况能正确应用约束，且62.1%的失败案例并非源于时间计算错误，而是源于将推理结果转化为适当对话响应的能力缺失。这揭示了当前大语言模型在时间推理与实际行为指导之间存在显著“应用鸿沟”，即模型具备一定的时序理解能力，但难以将其有效转化为符合时间约束的对话输出。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06839
作者: Peidi Dong,Yunze Xiao,Yu-Lin Tsai,Yichen Zheng,Heyuan Huang,Weihao Xuan,Mark Dredze,Jen-tse Huang
机构: Carnegie Mellon University; University of California, Berkeley; The Hong Kong Polytechnic University; Johns Hopkins University; The University of Tokyo; RIKEN AIP
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Preprint

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language model (LLM) assistants increasingly help users with everyday activities that involve time-dependent constraints. However, users may not mention these constraints in later requests, requiring assistants to recognize and adjust their advice accordingly. To evaluate such capability, we introduce TASC (Temporal Action Safety in Conversation), a benchmark that evaluates whether LLMs apply time-dependent constraints when responding to conversational requests. TASC consists of 3,418 inputs derived from 128 templates, along with a separate set of 33 scenarios designed to compare models’ ability to calculate elapsed time with their ability to apply that information. Across 13 models, assistants account for time-dependent constraints in only 30.5% of cases where the proposed action violates a rule, while rarely warning users unnecessarily. More importantly, models fail to apply these constraints in 62.1% of cases despite correctly calculating the elapsed time. Explicitly providing the timing resolves only about half of these failures, revealing a gap between temporal reasoning and its application in conversational advice.

[NLP-4] LooM: Loop-Invariant Memory for Causal Encoder-Decoder Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决循环变压器（Looped Transformers）在实际应用中面临的三大瓶颈问题：随着循环次数增加，内存占用持续增长；计算量只能以整块为单位调整；训练完成后难以灵活更改循环次数。其提出的解决方案——LooM（Loop-invariant Memory），通过在因果编码器-解码器（CED）架构中仅对首个解码层之后的层进行循环，并引入一种全局记忆机制，该记忆在每个输入标记（token）生成时仅写入一次，且每个解码层仅在其首次访问时发布对应标记的键值（KV）缓存条目，从而实现缓存大小与循环次数无关。此外，这些循环层可独立运行，支持每标记3至21次不等的执行次数，且无需路由网络（router），仅需一个在随机采样预算下训练的统一模型即可覆盖所有配置。实验表明，在足够多的循环次数下，LooM在语言建模、零样本准确率和长上下文困惑度等任务上均优于同等数据训练的单次前向传播基线模型，同时保持相同的缓存开销。进一步分析揭示，训练预算分布决定了额外深度所能带来的收益。研究结果表明，CED结构天然适合循环设计：记忆仅写入一次，而深度则可作为部署阶段按需选择的计算预算。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06835
作者: Lele Yang,Muxi Diao,Zhonghao Yan,Jiankang Chen,Bin Wen,Tingting Gao,Wentao Zhang,Kongming Liang,Zhanyu Ma,Weiran Xu
机构: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications (北京邮电大学); Zhongguancun Academy (中关村学院); Peking University (北京大学); Kling Team (Kling团队)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Looped Transformers increase effective depth by re-executing shared layers, but three limitations hinder their adoption: memory grows with the loop count, compute can only be adjusted in whole-block steps, and the loop count is hard to change after training. We propose LooM (Loop-invariant Memory), which addresses each in turn. In a causal encoder-decoder (CED), LooM loops only the decoder layers after the first, which read a global memory written once per token, and each of them publishes the key-value (KV) entry for a token only on its first visit, so the cache does not grow with the loop count. These layers loop independently, providing every budget from 3 to 21 layer executions per token, and one model trained on randomly sampled budgets covers all of them without a router. With enough loops, LooM outperforms a single-pass baseline trained on the same data on language modeling, zero-shot accuracy and long-context perplexity, while using the same cache size. Our analysis further shows that the training budget distribution decides what extra depth buys. These results suggest that a CED is a natural place to loop: memory is written once, and depth becomes a budget chosen at deployment.

[NLP-5] SAUCE: Summary Analysis Using Conversation Entailment ACL

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决跨语言对话语音摘要（cross-lingual conversational speech summarization）中缺乏明确评估目标时，难以准确衡量摘要质量的问题，尤其关注在语音转录与翻译误差导致的信息丢失以及摘要中幻觉或遗漏等缺陷的检测。其解决方案的关键在于提出SAUCE——一种无参考、基于事实的评估框架，通过判断对话内容与摘要之间的语义蕴含关系（entailment），量化摘要的事实准确性与事实覆盖率。相较于黑箱大语言模型评估器或密集嵌入型指标，SAUCE具备内在可解释性：将评分映射至可验证的具体事实，使用户能够精准定位幻觉或遗漏点。这一特性不仅帮助开发者系统性地分析大语言模型（LLM）的行为模式，也为终端用户提供了一种在噪声环境下的可操作工具以验证摘要的可靠性。初步实验表明，SAUCE与人工评价具有高度一致性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06812
作者: Man-Ling Sung,Hemanth Kandula,Jeff Ma,William Hartmann,Matthew Snover
机构: RTX BBN Technologies; Cambridge MA, USA
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Audio and Speech Processing (eess.AS)
备注: Accepted and published to the ACL GEM workshop. Proceedings of the Fifth Workshop on Generation, Evaluation and Metrics (GEM), pages 364-377, San Diego, California, USA. Association for Computational Linguistics

点击查看摘要

Abstract:With the growing need for evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) and their applications to speech, challenges persist in summarizing and evaluating conversations that lack a clear end goal. We introduce SAUCE – a reference-free, fact-based evaluation pipeline for cross-lingual conversational speech summarization. It measures the accuracy and the fact coverage of a summary through the entailment between conversation and text. We compare SAUCE against several popular summarization metrics and demonstrate the effectiveness of capturing information loss due to transcription and translation error and identifying broken summaries. Crucially, unlike black-box LLM evaluators or dense embedding metrics, SAUCE is inherently explainable: it maps summary scores to discrete, verifiable facts, allowing users to pinpoint exact hallucinations or omissions. We illustrate how this interpretability helps developers systematically profile LLM behaviors and gives end-users an actionable tool to verify summary accuracy in noisy, real-world conditions. Preliminary investigations show SAUCE strongly align with human judgment.

[NLP-6] LLM s Dont Know What They Know: Benchmarking Temporal Self-Knowledge for Financial Backtesting

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式AI在金融回测中可能因“知识泄露”（knowledge leakage）而产生虚假性能表现的问题，即模型在训练过程中已接触过未来数据，导致其预测能力被高估。现有实践通过依赖供应商声明的知识截止日期、模型自述认知状态或指令其以历史时间点作答等方式试图规避此问题，但这些方法的有效性缺乏验证。论文提出的关键解决方案是构建FinDendro——一个涵盖1999至2026年美国经济事实的基准数据集，包含2,226个带时间戳的事实，覆盖月度宏观经济指标、月末股票价格及美联储决策。该基准设计了四种类型提示：数值询问、回忆与预测（区分声称知晓或猜测）、以及带有历史声明日期的预测任务，结合持久性与主导结果控制，使随机准确率维持在约0.27。实证结果显示，多数前沿模型的自我报告存在显著低估真实知识水平的情况，例如GPT-5在可控事实中正确率达76%，但仅声称知晓38%；且其对“声称未知”的事实仍能正确回答61%。此外，知识宣称可延续至实际知识边界后长达七个季度，而明确声明历史日期虽能有效消除前置知识声称，却未影响预测准确性。因此，仅依靠自述、指令或声称的知识截止日期无法确保模型在训练窗口内进行回测时无知识泄露。研究强调需通过行为测量法识别模型的时间知识边界，而FinDendro为评估和选择基于实际事实认知能力的回测时段提供了可操作的基准与流程。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06808
作者: Lingfei Qian,Yan Wang,Xueqing Peng,Yupeng Cao,Yuechen Jiang,Zhuohan Xie,Anke Xu,Wenbo Cao,Jiarui Chen,Zehan Li,Jimin Huang,Alejandro Lopez-Lira,Yuehua Tang,Sophia Ananiadou,Jian-Yun Nie
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 20 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Financial backtests of large language models (LLMs) are meaningful only if the model did not already know the outcomes it is asked to predict. Practitioners guard against this by trusting a vendor’s stated knowledge cutoff, by asking the model what it knows, or by instructing it to answer as of a past date. To verify whether any of these safeguards can be trusted, we introduce FinDendro, a benchmark of 2,226 dated U.S. facts from 1999 to 2026, covering monthly macroeconomic series, month-end stock prices and Federal Reserve decisions. Each fact yields four prompts: a value question, Recall and Predict questions that pair each candidate value with a claim of knowing or guessing without a declared date, and a Predict question with a historical declared date. Controls for persistence and dominant outcomes keep chance accuracy near 0.27. Results show that for most frontier models, self-reports understate knowledge. GPT-5 answers 76% of controlled facts correctly but claims to know 38%, and answers 61% of the facts it says it does not know. Knowledge claims can persist beyond the measured knowledge boundary, by up to seven quarters, and a declared date removes most of the claims of prior knowledge while leaving accuracy unchanged. Backtests inside a model’s training window therefore cannot be certified leak-free by self-report, instruction or stated cutoff. These findings motivate behavioral measurement of temporal knowledge boundaries, and FinDendro provides a benchmark and procedure for selecting backtest periods based on demonstrated factual knowledge.

[NLP-7] Measuring Risk Not Harm: Detecting Psychological Harm Risk Factors in LLM Conversations

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）交互过程中可能引发的心理伤害（psychological harm）难以被直接监测的问题，尤其因为此类伤害往往在长期互动中逐步显现，并高度依赖于用户的主观个体情境。其核心解决方案在于将监测重点从“伤害”转向“风险”，即通过识别可观察的AI行为模式作为心理伤害的风险因素（risk factors），并在响应层面进行聚合分析，实现对用户-模型交互过程的纵向心理安全监控。关键创新在于构建了一个包含47,062条AI响应与373,873个响应-因子标签的合成多标签语料库，并定义了八类可操作化的风险行为；在此基础上，采用嵌入式分类器、直接大模型判断以及分类器-判别器级联三种方法进行检测，所有方法均为模型无关（model-agnostic），仅依赖于LLM输出，无需访问内部状态。实验表明，最优级联模型在独立测试集上达到宏平均精确率0.86、召回率0.76和F1值0.79，在WildChat数据集上使大模型判别调用次数减少97.1%，且在DelusionEval中风险因子检测结果呈现对话内聚性。研究验证了基于响应层行为风险因子的检测机制，能够为心理安全性提供可扩展、可量化的监测框架，避免将可观测的AI行为与潜在的用户内在伤害混淆。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06806
作者: Nil-Jana Akpinar,Eugenia Kim,Natalie Isak,Amanda Minnich,Victoria Westerhoff,Matthew Dressman
机构: Microsoft(微软)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computers and Society (cs.CY)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Psychological harms from interactions with large language models cannot be monitored directly because they may emerge over repeated interactions and depend strongly on subjective individual user context. We propose measuring risk, not harm: detecting observable AI behaviors that constitute risk factors for psychological harm at the AI response level and aggregating these signals to support longitudinal monitoring. We operationalize eight such behaviors and construct a synthetic multi-label corpus of 47,062 AI responses and 373,873 response-factor labels, with targeted human annotations for validation and evaluation. We then compare trained embedding-based classifiers, direct LLM judging, and a classifier–judge cascade. All detectors are model-agnostic and operate only on LLM outputs, requiring no access to internal model states. We apply these detectors to several out-of-distribution human-AI conversation data sets from prior research. On held-out human-labeled data, the best cascade achieves macro precision of 0.86, recall of 0.76, and F1 of 0.79. On WildChat, it reduces LLM-judge calls by 97.1% relative to direct judging. On DelusionEval, risk-factor detections cluster within conversations. Together, our results show that response-level behavioral risk-factor detection can provide a scalable measurement layer for longitudinal psychological-safety monitoring without conflating observable AI behavior with latent user harm.

[NLP-8] Ranking Agreement Does Not Reveal Parag raph-Edit Agreement in Two Released Paper Acceptance Predictors

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决如何高效筛选学术论文修订版本以供后续详细评估的问题，核心挑战在于验证快速接受分类器（fast acceptance classifier）是否能够有效预测哪些修订版本更可能被慢速评估者（slower evaluator）所接受。其解决方案的关键在于通过对比一个基于词与文档特征的分类器与两个从同一30亿参数语言模型微调得到的文本类接受预测器，在198篇国际学习表征会议（ICLR）论文及其自动筛选后的段落重写版本上进行评分一致性分析。研究发现，尽管分类器对原始论文的排名与其中一个预测器接近、与另一个中等一致，但在判断哪些重写版本会提升评分方面，分类器与两个预测器均无显著一致性。进一步分析表明，先前测试中因数值精度降低导致舍入误差主导了微小分数变化，因此在全32位精度下重新评分后，结果依然显示编辑选择与随机选择相比平均得分仅提高不足2分（满分100），且一致性仍趋近于零。该证据涵盖展示性重写及来自同一模型家族的两个开源预测器，但尚未验证其在实际高成本评估者中的适用性。因此，研究强调：任何用于筛选修订版本的分类器都必须在其预期评估者上进行实证校验，以确保其有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06789
作者: Shaoliang Yang,Jun Wang
机构: Santa Clara University (圣克拉拉大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 38 pages including supplementary methods and results; 10 figures and 22 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:A fast acceptance classifier could select revisions for a slower evaluator. We ask whether agreement on existing papers supports that use. We compare a classifier of word and document features with two released text-only acceptance predictors fine-tuned from the same language model with three billion parameters. For 198 papers from the International Conference on Learning Representations, we compare model rankings of the original papers and of paragraph rewrites screened automatically for unchanged facts, claim strength, and attribution. The classifier ranks original papers closely with one predictor and moderately with the other, but shows no detectable agreement with either on which rewrites raise scores. The tests specified in advance used reduced numerical precision. Rounding error dominated the small score responses. We therefore rescored the released weights in full 32-bit precision as a post hoc check; edit agreement remained near zero. At this precision, when each predictor chooses among five rewrites per paper, its average raw score is under two points out of 100 higher than with random choice. The evidence covers presentation rewrites and two open predictors from one family; transfer to costly evaluators remains untested. Revision selectors should therefore be checked against the intended evaluator on the revisions they rank.

[NLP-9] mplate Gap Reconstruction for Shell Output Simulation with Small Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决小型语言模型（Small Language Models, SLMs）在执行命令前模拟壳环境输出时，因需完整预测重复性结构与动态内容而带来的高计算开销与生成效率低下的问题。其核心挑战在于如何在保持输出准确性的同时降低生成负担。解决方案的关键是提出模板间隙重建（Template Gap Reconstruction, TGR）机制：通过构建包含1870万条跨异构执行环境输出的模板库，将输出分解为可复用的固定文本片段（即模板）与由占位符（sentinels）分隔的自回归生成间隙；系统采用模板选择器动态决定使用哪个模板进行重建，其中空模板仍保留全输出解码能力。实验表明，当最优模板覆盖超过25%的输出时，TGR在输出编辑相似度（O-ES）上显著优于全输出解码（FOD），尤其在短间隙序列中表现更优（O-ES分别为0.964与0.812），同时在不同分词器下减少26.3%–38.3%的生成标记数。该方法验证了利用可复用输出结构作为实际设计选择的有效性，兼顾响应保真度、生成目标缩短，并将模板选择与残差预测作为影响生成质量的核心要素。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06731
作者: Jarrod Ragsdale,Rajendra Boppana
机构: 未知
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 25 pages, 7 figures, 12 tables, conference preprint

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Small language models offer a compact basis for shell simulation without executing submitted commands, but full-output decoding requires them to predict recurring utility structure alongside content that varies across executions. We introduce template gap reconstruction (TGR), which supplies reusable output literals interspersed with sentinels to be interleaved with autoregressively generated gaps. A template selector chooses which template to be reconstructed, with the empty template retaining full-output decoding. We construct a template bank from 18.7 million outputs collected across heterogeneous execution environments and train a template selector and five reconstruction models initialized from various small language model checkpoints on a target environment excluded from bank construction. Evaluation demonstrates that TGR improves output edit similarity (O-ES) over full-output decoding (FOD) when the optimal template covers more than 25% of the template, while performing similarly for lower-coverage outputs. Additionally, TGR outperforms FOD for shorter gap sequences, with O-ES values of 0.964 and 0.812, respectively, while maintaining similar performance for longer sequences. TGR reduces the number of tokens generated by 26.3–38.3% across used tokenizer families. These results support using a reusable output structure as a practical design choice for small shell simulators, improving response fidelity and shortening generation targets while keeping template selection and residual prediction central to response quality.

[NLP-10] urns Matter: Advancing Streaming Video RL via Turn-Level Credit

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决流式视频理解任务中因采用轨迹级（trajectory-level）优势函数导致的决策不一致问题，即现有基于组相对策略优化（GRPO）的方法在多轮交互中共享同一轨迹级优势信号，造成早期成功后冗余回复增强、早期失败后有用后续响应被抑制的现象。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种逐轮（turn-wise）GRPO框架——TurnWise，通过引入逐轮信用分配机制，利用“静默完成前缀评分”（silence-completed prefix scoring）构建每一轮决策的剩余回报（remaining return），从而实现从前期奖励中解耦的独立学习信号。同时，采用逐轮均值策略优化（turn-mean policy optimization），在每轮内平均词元损失，并跨轮次进行加权平均，使回应与等待决策获得同等权重，不受输出长度影响。上述设计共同提升了流式交互中决策的时效性与信息密度，无需额外的值函数网络或滚动采样即可显著改善策略学习效果，在多个基准测试中优于现有强化学习方法。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06728
作者: Shuai Dong,Kanghui Tian,Linghan Chen,Wenqi Shao,Hongrui Wu,Haowen Hou,Yongfu Zhu,Xuehui Wang,Ziyue Wang,Wenpu Liu,Weichu Xie,Yuqi Xu,Congcong Wang,Kaiwen Tuo,Caoyuan Ma,Taiqiang Wu,Ji Zhao,Wenzheng Chang,Dianyi Wang,Siyuan Wang,Zhongyu Wei,Yu Qiao,Jiaqi Wang
机构: 未知
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 16 pages, 4 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Streaming video understanding requires models to repeatedly decide whether to respond or continue observing. Recently, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has been applied to this setting, with existing approaches emphasizing reward design while retaining a single trajectory-level advantage across turns. Such shared credit can reinforce redundant replies after earlier successes and discourage useful follow-ups after earlier failures. We propose TurnWise, a turn-level GRPO framework that aligns learning with individual streaming decisions. TurnWise addresses the mismatch between trajectory-level feedback and turn-level interaction, promoting informative responses and reducing redundancy. Specifically, turn-level credit assignment uses silence-completed prefix scoring to construct group-relative advantages from each decision’s remaining return, separating its learning signal from earlier rewards. Turn-mean policy optimization averages token losses within each turn and then across turns, giving response and waiting decisions equal weight regardless of output length. These complementary designs improve streaming policy learning without a learned critic or additional rollouts. Extensive experiments show our method outperforms prior RL approaches for streaming video understanding.

[NLP-11] Reasoning over Non-Parametric Memory in Multilingual LLM s: A Cognitive-Based Analysis of Relational Knowledge

【速读】： 该论文旨在探究生成式 AI（Generative AI）在给定明确事实条件下的关系推理能力，即模型能否基于提示中直接提供的关系信息进行逻辑推断，而非依赖预训练阶段记忆的关联模式。其核心问题是：当前大语言模型在处理需要深层次推理的任务时，是否真正具备对显式提供关系证据的建模与推理能力。解决方案的关键在于构建一个受控的多语言诊断基准——Rel-Bloom，该基准包含450道多选题，基于30个Wikidata关系，以五种认知层级（记忆、理解、应用、分析、评估）和三种真实性情境（事实性、反事实性、中性化）进行系统设计。通过在43个模型、六种语言及两种多语言设置下进行大规模测试（共226,800次预测），研究发现：模型性能在“应用”到“分析”层级间显著下降，尤其在大型开源模型中降幅达47.2个百分点；“评估”类任务始终是瓶颈，即使在其他层级接近满分的Gemini 3.1 Pro，其“评估”得分也仅为60.7%；且不同语言间题目与关系的难度排序高度一致，表明存在跨语言共享的内在难度结构。此外，反事实情境普遍更难，而去除实体身份信息在某些模型中反而有助于提升高层级表现。这些结果表明，模型规模或能力提升并不能自动保证其对显式关系证据的可靠推理，揭示了当前生成式 AI 在复杂推理任务中的深层局限性。

Abstract:Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) assumes that language models can reason over relations stated in their context rather than fall back on associations memorized during pretraining. We study this evidence-conditioned relational reasoning in isolation, with the facts supplied directly in the prompt rather than retrieved. \textscRel-Bloom is a controlled multilingual diagnostic of 450 multiple-choice questions built from 30 Wikidata relations; the same source relations are instantiated at five Bloom-inspired levels (Remember, Understand, Apply, Analyze, Evaluate) and under three veracity conditions (Factual, Counterfactual, Neutralized). Across 43 models, six languages, and two multilingual settings (226,800 predictions), three findings stand out. First, accuracy drops sharply from Apply to Analyze in every evaluated open-weight model series, reaching 47.2 percentage points for the Large Granite bucket, but not for either Gemini model. Second, Evaluate items remain a bottleneck even for models near ceiling on the other task types: Gemini~3.1 Pro averages 99.5% on the other four levels but 60.7% on Evaluate. Third, item- and relation-level difficulty rankings are consistently preserved across languages, indicating a difficulty structure partly shared across languages within this benchmark. Across knowledge conditions, Counterfactual contexts are generally harder than Factual ones, while removing entity identities can improve higher-level performance in some model regimes. Greater model capability therefore does not by itself ensure reliable reasoning over supplied relational evidence. Relevant resources are available at: this https URL.

[NLP-12] ALTO: African and Levantine Tech-Facilitated Gender-Based Violence Corpus

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式AI（Generative AI）时代下，技术赋能的性别暴力（Tech-facilitated Gender-Based Violence, TFGBV）在多元语言与文化语境中检测能力不足的问题，尤其针对全球南方（Global South）语言如黎凡特阿拉伯语、非洲法语和斯瓦希里语中存在的性别化伤害内容缺乏有效识别模型与标注数据集的困境。其解决方案的关键在于采用由社区主导的众包方法，联合约旦、西非法语区及肯尼亚的民间社会组织（CSOs），收集具有文化与语言相关性的TFGBV实例，并基于主动学习（active learning）对数据进行标注，构建了一个小规模但性能优异的数据集ALTO（N=3022）。通过基准测试与微调实验表明，现有有害内容检测模型在ALTO数据集上对TFGBV的召回率表现不佳，经微调后显著提升；同时发现模型普遍遗漏隐性形式的性别暴力，且在斯瓦希里语中的错误率尤为突出。研究不仅报告了实证结果，还公开发布了注释分类体系、数据集及训练模型，为提升多语言环境下性别暴力内容的检测能力提供了可复用的技术基础与社会参与范式。

作者: Tianwei Zhang,Ivy Njoki Nyagwencha,Zahraa Dirani,Shalini Joshi,Scott A. Hale
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computers and Society (cs.CY); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Tech-facilitated gender based violence (TFGBV) is a pervasive online harm affecting women and gender minority groups through its many direct and covert forms. Current models and annotated datasets for gendered harm detection are dominated by data from, and models trained in, Global North languages. In collaboration with civil society organizations (CSOs) from Jordan, Francophone West Africa, and Kenya, we developed a community-led approach to crowdsource culturally and linguistically relevant instances of TFGBV in Levantine Arabic, African French, and Swahili. We annotated the crowdsourced data using active learning to develop a small but performant dataset (N=3022) called ALTO to improve TFGBV detection in the three languages. Through benchmarking and fine-tuning experiments, we show that existing harmful content detection models show poor TFGBV recall within ALTO and improve with fine-tuning. We found that models often miss covert harms across all languages, while error rates are markedly higher in Swahili. We report the experimental results and release the annotation taxonomy, dataset, and trained models.

[NLP-13] Beyond accuracy: what AI assurance needs to establish in public services

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决公共部门在决策与服务提供中依赖生成式AI（Generative AI）输出时所面临的可靠性与问责性问题，特别是如何评估这些自动化生成的分类、摘要与评估结果是否可信。其核心挑战在于：现有基于整体准确率的评估方法无法充分揭示模型输出的不稳定性、系统性偏差及治理盲区。解决方案的关键在于构建一个融合技术评估与治理分析的双重框架，结合测量理论与基于管理的监管机制，强调超越平均准确率的多维验证。研究通过对比八种GPT-4o配置对1200次英国首相问答的分类表现，发现尽管整体准确率在68.2%至70.3%之间，但约24.3%的问题标签存在显著变动，且不同配置间一致性高于与人工标注的一致性，表明高一致并不等同于正确。同时，基于评分提取的需人工复核比例差异巨大（0.9%–41.0%），暴露出评估流程的不可靠性。进一步分析37份英欧政策文件发现，虽均要求测试与监督，但对输出变化、共现错误、选择性评估、实质性结论及审查路径等关键治理要素缺乏一致规范。因此，论文主张公共政策应强制要求组织通过多维度核查——包括非平均性能指标、明确责任归属、专家可及性以及结果的透明审查——来正当化对生成式AI证据的依赖，以确保公共治理的可信性与问责性。

类目: Computers and Society (cs.CY); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 20 pages, 6 tables, 2 figures

Abstract:Public bodies increasingly rely on AI-produced evidence, including classifications, summaries and assessments. These outputs can inform policy decisions and service delivery, making their reliability a matter of public accountability. Establishing whether this evidence can be relied upon requires testing its outputs and examining how organisations decide whether those tests are sufficient. We combine technical evaluation with analysis of AI governance requirements, informed by measurement theory and management-based regulation. We compare eight GPT-4o configurations classifying 1,200 UK Prime Minister’s Questions into 21 policy topics, against human-coded labels and across unchanged repeats. Accuracy ranges from 68.2% to 70.3%, yet 24.3% of questions receive different labels, with changes in topic shares and rankings. Configurations agree more with one another than with human coding: agreement does not guarantee correctness. Under the implemented score-extraction procedure, the proportion flagged for human review ranges from 0.9% to 41.0%. We analyse 37 UK and EU policy documents. Both sets expect testing and oversight, but reporting expectations do not consistently cover changing answers, shared errors, selective evaluation, substantive conclusions or review routing. Some UK guidance explicitly addresses stability. The UK sample emphasises public bodies checking their own use; the EU places substantial testing duties on providers while leaving them important choices about measures and acceptance thresholds. Without appropriate checks, evidence could misrepresent policy issues, redirect attention or resources, and leave errors undetected. Public policy should require organisations to justify reliance through checks beyond aggregate accuracy, clear responsibility, access to expertise and scrutiny of results.

[NLP-14] Replicability Reproducibility and Robustness in Political and Social Science Research with Large Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）研究中因输出的随机性导致的可复现性问题。由于LLM输出具有概率特性，且在不同模型及版本间存在差异，这种不确定性可能对下游统计结果产生显著影响。论文区分了可重复性（replicability）、可复现性（reproducibility）与鲁棒性（robustness）的概念，并提出一种基于结果分布而非完全相同输出的 probabilistic 标准。其解决方案的关键在于引入标准化提示脚本（standardized prompt script），测试编码器与解码器内部的模型变异性，并发展误差结构分析方法以诊断模型错误模式及其一致性。通过三个数据集的实证研究发现，测量方式的选择可能导致下游回归系数符号反转。尽管基于设计的校正方法（如使用金标准标注子样本）可恢复估计的有效性，但会牺牲估计精度。本文的核心贡献是构建了一个基于开源权重的堆叠集成模型（stacked ensemble of open-weight models），在保持估计有效性的同时显著提升了校正步骤中的估计精度。

作者: Joan C. Timoneda,Sebastián Vallejo Vera
机构: Purdue University (普渡大学); University of Western Ontario (西安大略大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computers and Society (cs.CY)
备注: Chapter 5 of “LLMs in Political and Social Science: Principles and Applications of Transformer Models,” Oxford University Press, forthcoming 2027. Data and code: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:This chapter addresses the central reproducibility problem of research with large language models. LLM output is probabilistic and varies across models and versions, which can have significant effects on downstream statistical results. The chapter distinguishes between replicability, reproducibility, and robustness, and proposes a probabilistic standard based on the distribution of results, not identical outputs. It introduces a standardized prompt script, tests within-model variation for encoders and decoders, and develops error-structure analysis to diagnose where models err and whether their errors align. Using three datasets, the chapter shows that measurement choice can reverse the sign of downstream regression coefficients. Existing design-based corrections with gold-labeled subsamples restore validity, but come at the cost of estimate precision. The main contribution of the chapter is a stacked ensemble of open-weight models that improves precision in the correction step while retaining estimate validity.

[NLP-15] When Do Summaries Become Instructions? Unsupported Policy in LLM Agents Self-Written Handoff Summaries

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）在长期运行的大语言模型（LLM）智能体中，因上下文压缩导致的“权限与要求误传”问题，即智能体在生成摘要时可能引入原始记录中未支持的权限或限制性语句。其核心问题是：这些手递手（handoff）摘要中的限制或授权声明是否超出原始上下文所允许的范围，是否影响后续智能体实例（继承者）的行为，以及此类语句的来源为何。解决方案的关键在于通过构建合成工具使用任务以建立真实权限清单（ground-truth permission ledger），并采用同快照重放（same-snapshot replay）方法，将摘要中的可疑语句替换为中性填充物，从而评估其对行为的影响。实验结果表明，两个开源权重模型的可读摘要中分别存在1.2%和2.4%的不支持限制、0.1%和1.3%的不支持授权；进一步干预显示，通过修改系统提示，明确说明需求来源，可显著降低不支持性限制的比例（从5.0%降至1.8%，持例模板下从1.8%降至0.3%），且统计显著（p < 10⁻⁹）。此外，大多数开发阶段的限制源于智能体自身先前推理中“需审批”的逻辑链条。该研究揭示了上下文压缩机制中隐含的语义偏移风险，并提出通过显式规则溯源来缓解此类问题的策略。

作者: Wenhui Chu
机构: University at Albany, State University of New York(纽约州立大学阿尔巴尼分校)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 22 pages, 3 figures, 15 tables. Code and data: this https URL

Abstract:Long-running LLM agents compact their context, replacing most history with a summary. We ask whether handoff summaries state permissions or requirements the record does not support, whether such sentences change what the next instance (the successor) does, and where they come from. Synthetic tool-use tasks carry a ground-truth permission ledger; same-snapshot replay reruns the successor with those whole sentences replaced by neutral filler. Two AI readers, reading only rule-flagged held-out summaries, confirmed unsupported restrictions in 1.2% and 2.4% of all readable summaries from two open-weight models, and unsupported authorizations in 0.1% and 1.3%. For restrictions, a pre-specified replay test was not significant (p = 0.58); a follow-up, planned after it, found a fragile effect (p = 0.027). Neutralizing false approvals cut unauthorized actions from 24 to 7 of 120 held-out runs (post hoc; later set: 17 to 11 of 48). Most development restrictions followed the agent’s earlier reasoning that an action needs approval (post hoc). In pre-specified tests, replacing the system prompt’s “Some actions need approval.” with one saying where requirements come from cut unsupported restrictions from 5.0% to 1.8% of development summaries and, on held-out templates, from 1.8% to 0.3% (both p 10^-9), while requests for approvals the ledger requires barely changed. [NLP-16] Dialect Matters: A Dialect-Aware Baseline for Igala-English Machine Translation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决伊加拉语（Igala）这一低资源语言在自然语言处理（Natural Language Processing, NLP）领域缺乏平行语料库的问题，尤其针对伊加拉语内部存在的方言差异尚未被系统建模的挑战。现有研究虽已尝试缓解低资源语言的瓶颈，但伊加拉语仍无任何公开可用的双语平行语料库。为此，本文提出首个面向伊加拉语-英语机器翻译的方言感知基线模型，首次构建了带有方言标签的1137句语料库（其中训练集899句），涵盖伊达（Idah, 40.4%）、安帕（Ankpa, 26.1%）、伊巴吉（Ibaji, 14.1%）、其他（Other, 16.4%）及奥古古（Ogugu, 2.8%）等方言变体。关键解决方案在于引入方言标签并采用混合方言训练策略，实证表明：仅使用伊达方言训练的模型在伊巴吉方言上性能下降4.7 BLEU，而混合方言训练则实现更均衡的表现（BLEU 11.66），验证了方言多样性融合对提升模型公平性的重要性。模型基于Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-en-mul（78M参数）进行微调，经消融实验确定最佳收敛周期为8轮，超过15轮出现过拟合；最终达到BLEU 11.66、chrF 46.69的性能指标。语料规模与性能趋势符合非洲低资源语言文献中的对数线性规律，本研究首次提供了伊加拉语的方言影响分析，并建立了未来相关工作的基准。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The massive permeability of intelligent systems in every sphere of human activities have greatly enhanced clarity, ease of work, and increased general global understanding which has significantly awaken the use of intelligent systems by all users. Intelligent systems greatly rely on precise dataset/corpus for the correctness of their output. Despite efforts by researchers to address Low-resource language in the Natural Language Processing (NLP), Igala still has zero parallel corpora despite efforts by researchers. We present a dialect-aware baseline for Igala-English machine translation, among first open systems and first with dialectal variation analysis. Our dataset of 1137 sentences (899 training) is first with dialect tags: Idah 459 (40.4%), Ankpa 297 (26.1%), Ibaji 160 (14.1%), Other 187 (16.4%), Ogugu 32 (2.8%). Same English yields 20-60 Igala forms. Mixed-dialect training achieves balanced BLEU 11.66 versus Idah-only model which drops 4.7 BLEU on Ibaji (13.2 on Idah, 8.5 on Ibaji), proving dialect fairness requires mixing. Fine-tuned from Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-en-mul (78M), epoch ablation shows convergence at 8 epochs and overfitting at 15. BLEU 11.66, chrF 46.69. Analysis shows 899 sentences on log-linear trend consistent with African low-resource literature. This work provides first dialectal impact analysis for Igala and establishes baseline for future work.

[NLP-17] NaijaFacts: A Framework for Disentangling Language from Knowledge in Facts about Nigeria

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前多语言非洲语言基准测试中存在的核心缺陷：现有评估主要依赖将通用问题翻译至当地语言，仅衡量模型的语义理解能力，而未能检验其对非洲真实事实的认知水平。为此，研究提出 \textit{aija} 基准，一个聚焦尼日利亚的事实性与统计类问题集合，由母语者编写并基于权威官方统计数据，所有问题均以英语、尼日利亚皮钦语、约鲁巴语、伊博语和豪萨语五种语言呈现。通过构建“国家-语言”矩阵（country-by-language matrix），该方法能够解耦语言效应（模型知晓事实但在低资源语言中表现下降）与知识效应（事实本身在所有语言中均缺失）。实验结果表明，知识效应占据主导地位：在针对美国和英国的问题上，英文查询准确率可达49–50%，而对尼日利亚数据的准确率仅为20%；语言效应则较小且与网络文本代表性相关，从英语到约鲁巴语的性能下降达9个百分点（尼日利亚问题），最高达24个百分点（美国/英国问题）。进一步验证显示，模型规模提升并未缓解此差距——最强模型在美英问题上达到66–79%准确率，但在尼日利亚统计数据任务上均未超过31%。将该分析扩展至全非洲54个国家，发现相同模式普遍存在：文化类问题准确率达96%，政治类达98%，但统计类问题仅26%，说明该知识鸿沟并非局限于尼日利亚，而是非洲整体认知覆盖不足的体现。

类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multilingual benchmarks for African languages mostly translate generic questions into local languages, measuring linguistic competence but not whether models know facts about Africa. We introduce \naija, a benchmark of factual and statistical questions about Nigeria, authored by native speakers and grounded in authoritative official statistics, with every question available in English, Nigerian Pidgin, \yoruba, Igbo, and Hausa. Answering similar questions for the UK and US yields a country by language matrix that disentangles a language effect (the model knows the fact but degrades in a low-resource language) from a knowledge effect (the fact is absent in every language). Across eight frontier and Nigeria-adapted models, the knowledge effect dominates: English-query accuracy is 49–50% for the US/UK but 20% for Nigeria. The language effect is smaller and tracks web representation, degrading from English to \yoruba (9 points on Nigeria, up to 24 on US/UK questions). We find scale does not help: the strongest models reach 66–79% on the UK and the US but none exceed 31% on Nigerian statistics. Extending to all 54 African countries with our best performing frontier model shows the same profile continent-wide, 96% on culture and 98% on politics against 26% on statistics, so the gap is not specific to Nigeria.

[NLP-18] CRESiST: Self-Enhancing Explorative Policy Learning for Simultaneous Speech Translation NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决同步语音翻译（Simultaneous Speech Translation, SimulST）中翻译质量与延迟之间的权衡问题。现有基于大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）的SimulST系统主要依赖前缀增量生成（prefix-incremental generation）范式，存在关键缺陷：重复的键值（Key-Value, KV）缓存重新计算以及对额外语音活动检测（Voice Activity Detection, VAD）的依赖，难以处理无界流式输入。为克服上述瓶颈，本文提出一种基于全模态大语言模型（omni-modal LLM）的端到端交错读写（interleaved read-write）框架，通过交错排列语音片段与文本标记，实现完整的KV缓存复用，原生支持无需分段、无限长度的推理。此外，为在不依赖严格离线对齐的情况下学习最优流式策略，设计了一种新型的演员-评论家自增强（Actor-Critic self-enhancement）训练管道：采用基于RNN-T的演员（Actor）动态采样读写轨迹，由基于LLM的评论家（Critic）通过内在语义与延迟奖励评估路径，并将最优策略回传至演员进行优化。大量实验在句子级（FLEURS、CoVoST2）和文档级（MuST-C、ACL 60/60）基准上验证了所提方法在质量-延迟帕累托前沿上的显著优势，全面超越现有级联式与静态对齐基线。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06501
作者: Chenyang Le,Pei Zhang,Yuxiang Chen,Bing Han,Derek F. Wong,Baosong Yang,Yanmin Qian
机构: Shanghai Jiao Tong University (上海交通大学); Alibaba Token Hub, Alibaba Group (阿里巴巴令牌中心，阿里巴巴集团); University of Macau (澳门大学); University College London (伦敦大学学院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Sound (cs.SD)
备注: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Simultaneous Speech Translation (SimulST) requires balancing translation quality and latency. While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel in offline translation, current LLM-based SimulST systems predominantly rely on prefix-incremental generation. This paradigm suffers from redundant Key-Value cache recomputation and necessitates external Voice Activity Detection to process unbounded streams. To overcome these bottlenecks, we propose an end-to-end interleaved read-write framework built upon an omni-modal LLM. By interleaving speech chunks and text tokens, our architecture achieves full KV cache reuse, natively supporting segmentation-free, infinite-length inference. Furthermore, to learn optimal streaming policies without rigid offline alignments, we introduce a novel Actor-Critic self-enhancement pipeline. An RNN-T Actor dynamically samples read-write trajectories, while an LLM-based Critic evaluates these paths via intrinsic semantic and latency rewards, distilling the optimal policy back to the Actor. Extensive experiments on sentence-level (FLEURS, CoVoST2) and document-level (MuST-C, ACL 60/60) benchmarks demonstrate that our model establishes new state-of-the-art quality-latency Pareto frontiers, substantially outperforming existing cascaded and static-alignment baselines.

[NLP-19] LibriSpeech-Real-QA: A Benchmark for Streaming Question Answering ICASSP2027

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前语音大语言模型（Speech Large Language Models, SLMs）普遍采用离线处理模式，无法有效支持实时流式语音交互的问题。在实际应用场景中，如连续计数某人姓名出现次数等任务，要求系统能够基于不断流入的音频片段实时生成响应，而现有模型通常需等待完整语音段落接收完毕才开始推理，难以满足低延迟交互需求。为此，论文提出LibriSpeech-Real-QA数据集与基准评测体系，通过在LibriSpeech语料基础上构建多样化的实时问答对，评估SLMs在流式音频中识别目标词的能力。其解决方案的关键在于设计适用于实时语音交互的建模架构，并成功使预训练语音大模型具备在音频流过程中持续推理的能力，从而建立了一个可复现、可比较的基准，为后续研究提供了重要基础。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06496
作者: Zewen Zhan,Hui Lu,Xueyuan Chen,Huimeng Wang,Yikai Huang,Xixin Wu,Shiyin Kang,Bin Xia,Zhiyong Wu
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 5 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Most speech large language models (SLMs) still process speech in an offline manner. They only start responding after they receive the complete speech segment. However, many real-world applications require streaming speech interaction, for which the audio continuously flows in and the machine is required to answer questions based on the so far received audio chunks. For example, a user may ask the system to continuously count how many times a person’s name has been mentioned while they are speaking. We observe a lack of benchmarks and evaluation protocols for real-time speech interaction. Motivated by this, we propose LibriSpeech-Real-QA, a dataset and a benchmark for real-time speech interaction. We construct different types of real-time question-answer pairs from LibriSpeech to evaluate whether speech LLMs can identify target words in streaming audio. We evaluate several popular real-time commercial models and find that they still tend to respond only after the speech turn has finished. We demonstrate that we can enable a pretrained SLM to perform this task, where we explore several modeling designs and establish a solid baseline for future research.

[NLP-20] What Does Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning Really Improve in LLM Agents ?

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多轮代理强化学习（multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning, RL）在长时序任务中对交互预算（interaction budget）高度敏感的问题，即当采样广度 KKK 与交互深度 TTT 受限时，其性能显著下降。研究发现，基于轨迹的强化学习优势依赖于充足的轮次预算，且代理强化学习并非普遍提升单步决策质量，其核心优势集中体现在错误恢复能力与长时序任务中的鲁棒性。为缓解由此带来的部署风险，论文探讨了过程监督信号的优劣，并提出一种名为BudgetMix RL的新方法——在训练过程中动态调整交互预算，从而增强模型在不同执行环境下的适应性。实验表明，BudgetMix RL能够在多种执行设置下保持稳健的性能表现。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06483
作者: Kejian Zhu,Zhuoran Jin,Shangqing Tu,Tianyi Men,Yupu Hao,Jiachun Li,Kang Liu,Jun Zhao
机构: 未知
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Project Page: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:While multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning (RL) excels on long-horizon tasks, its performance gains remain highly sensitive to interaction constraints. Evaluating across sampling breadth K and interaction depth T via Pass@(K,T) , we show that trajectory-level RL advantages depend on sufficient turn budgets, diminishing significantly when budgets tighten. Besides, agentic RL does not uniformly elevate single-step decision quality; rather, its strength concentrates in error recovery and long-horizon resilience. To mitigate the deployment risks caused by this budget dependence, we provide a preliminary discussion on the benefits and limitations of process supervision signals and introduce BudgetMix RL as an alternative that varies interaction budgets during training. Experiments demonstrate that BudgetMix RL achieves robust performance across diverse execution settings. Project Page: this https URL

[NLP-21] EvoGuard: Mitigating Degradation in Online Skill Evolution

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式语言智能体在在线演化技能过程中出现的技能退化问题。现有方法通常在离线状态下基于多任务收集的轨迹批量更新技能，但存在两类缺陷：其一，直接采纳新技能而不进行验证，易导致性能下降；其二，仅在保持验证集性能提升时才保留新技能，虽有效却因频繁运行私有测试集评估而带来高延迟与高成本。针对上述挑战，本文提出EvoGuard，一种低延迟、低成本的成对技能选择器。其核心在于：首先通过迭代运行智能体构建技能池，并在私有测试集上为各技能打分以获得效用标签；随后将技能两两配对，并利用拒绝采样筛选出具有明显效用差异的配对样本；进而训练一个基于两个标签词logits的判别模型，以选择更优技能。部署时，该选择器仅需一次前向传播即可完成决策，显著快于传统测试集评估。实验表明，相较于无筛选地采纳所有新技能，EvoGuard在ALFWorld上提升成功率11.0%，在ScienceWorld上提升5.9%，在LiveCodeBench上提升2.7%。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06444
作者: Yanli Wang,Zichen Bai,Tianyue Jiang,Kunming Shao,Junhao Shi,Xueqin Liu,Jinguo Sun,Muye Li,Tingting Bi,Yanlin Wang,Shaoqiang Zheng,Xuefei Diao,Zhuwei Zeng,Nan Duan,Peng Cao
机构: JD.Com; Sun Yat-sen University (中山大学); The University of Melbourne (墨尔本大学); The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (香港科技大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 16 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables, including appendices

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Skills let language agents reuse experience across tasks as natural-language documents. Recent work evolves skills from interaction, but existing methods have limitations when skills evolve online. Prior methods update a skill offline from a batch of trajectories collected over many tasks. Some then adopt the new skill without any check, which can degrade the skill over time. Others keep it only if it improves performance on a held-out validation set, which is too slow and costly to run after every update. We introduce EvoGuard, a pairwise skill selector that mitigates skill degradation at low latency and cost. We first run the agent iteratively to build pools of skills and score each skill on a private test set to obtain utility labels. We pair the skills and use rejection sampling to keep only pairs with a clear utility gap. The selector is trained on the logits of two label tokens to pick the better skill. At deployment it decides in a single forward pass, which is significantly faster than evaluation on the private test set. Compared with adopting every new skill, EvoGuard improves success by 11.0% on ALFWorld, 5.9% on ScienceWorld, and 2.7% on LiveCodeBench.

[NLP-22] wists and Turns: A Graph-Based Benchmark and Framework for Long-Term Memory in Exploration Tasks

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决长期探索任务（long-term exploration tasks）中模型记忆与推理能力不足的问题，尤其针对科学探究和软件开发等需要持续迭代优化的复杂过程。现有长时记忆研究多聚焦于事实性信息的存储与更新，忽视了探索过程中各尝试方案之间的动态关联性与演化结构。论文提出的关键解决方案是构建一个基于图结构的基准测试框架——LExMem，将探索过程建模为具有分支、修正与重审关系的图网络，并通过进化机制生成具有高结构复杂性的对话与问答数据集（共224条对话，2,018个问答实例）。在此基础上，进一步提出LExGraph，一种基于图的记忆框架，通过增量式组织对话为互联的记忆节点，并结合混合检索与邻域扩展策略实现高效证据召回。实验表明，该方法在面对复杂探索轨迹时显著优于现有系统，具备更强的泛化能力。

作者: Chongyuan Dai,Yaling Shen,Zirui Song,Junfeng Liao,Jinpeng Hu,Xiuying Chen
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 29 pages, 5 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Long-term problem-solving processes, such as scientific research and software development, proceed along an evolving trial-and-error trajectory toward a central goal. We term these \textitexploration tasks, which require models to remember not only facts but also how solutions are tested against intermediate outcomes and early attempts are continually revised or revived. However, existing long-term memory research focuses on factual recall and updates, overlooking the interconnected nature of exploration. We observe that exploration processes naturally form graphs, with branching approaches linked by revisions and reconsiderations. Motivated by this, we propose \textscLExMem, a graph-guided benchmark designed to evaluate \underline\textscMemory in \underline\textscLong-term \underline\textscExploration tasks. We model exploration processes as graphs and introduce an evolutionary mechanism to increase their structural complexity, yielding 224 dialogues and 2,018 question-answer instances derived from graph structures. Building on the same insight, we propose \textscLExGraph, a graph-based memory framework that incrementally organizes dialogues into interconnected memory nodes and retrieves evidence through hybrid retrieval and neighbor expansion. Extensive experiments demonstrate that \textscLExMem poses a significant challenge to existing retrieval- and memory-based systems, whereas \textscLExGraph achieves superior performance and generalizes effectively to external benchmarks. Codes and datasets are available at this https URL.

[NLP-23] Ruby-OPD: Enhancing Pronunciation Controllability and Accuracy for Flow-Matching Text-to-Speech via On-Policy Distillation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决日语文本到语音（TTS）中高发音准确率与细粒度控制难以兼顾的核心问题。由于日语为非分词语言，其书写系统混合使用表意的汉字（Kanji）与表音的假名（Kana），且存在大量多音字现象，导致发音歧义严重。传统级联式TTS系统虽能通过前端文本转音素模块实现发音控制，但会丢失词汇语义和语调线索；而近年兴起的零样本TTS模型虽能直接处理原始文字以提升自然度，却面临多音字错误频发且缺乏显式发音控制的缺陷。本文提出一种两阶段流匹配TTS框架：关键创新在于引入带正则化扰动的“Ruby”文本表示，以联合保留表面字形与目标发音信息，确保可控性；同时在大规模纯文本语料上采用基于策略的蒸馏（On-Policy Distillation, OPD），无需配对语音即可显著提升原始文字输入下的发音准确性。在Joyo-Kanji-Yomi基准测试中，该方法在保持强可控性的前提下，实现了97.13%的发音准确率、2.02%的目标音素错误率（PER）、0.70%的句子级PER以及4.21%的句子级字符错误率（CER）。

作者: Rui Hu,Xiaolong Lin,Zhenpeng Zhan
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 5 pages, 3 tables, work in progress

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Achieving both high pronunciation accuracy and fine-grained controllability remains a central challenge in Japanese text-to-speech (TTS), as Japanese is an unsegmented language mixing logographic Kanji and phonographic Kana with extensive polyphony. Traditional cascaded systems convert text into phoneme sequences via a front-end, ensuring pronunciation control but discarding lexical semantics and prosodic cues in surface orthography. Conversely, recent zero-shot TTS models directly consume raw orthographic text to improve naturalness, yet suffer from polyphone errors and lack explicit pronunciation control. To bridge this gap, we propose a two-stage framework for flow-matching TTS. First, we investigate Ruby text representations with orthography perturbation to jointly preserve surface forms and target pronunciations for reliable control. Second, we introduce On-Policy Distillation (OPD) on large-scale text-only corpora to enhance pronunciation accuracy on raw orthographic text without paired speech. On the Joyo-Kanji-Yomi benchmark, our model achieves 97.13% Accuracy, 2.02% Target PER, 0.70% Sentence PER, and 4.21% Sentence CER under raw text while retaining strong controllability.

[NLP-24] Interpretable Text Embeddings Based on Hierarchical Questions

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决基于问答的文本嵌入（QA-based text embeddings）在实际应用中面临的两大挑战：一是生成高解释性嵌入通常需要人工审阅大量问题，导致效率低下；二是问题数量与问题粒度之间的权衡关系尚未得到充分研究。为此，论文提出一种构建层次化问题结构的方法，通过递归聚类、对比提示（contrastive prompting）和问题对齐技术，构建从粗粒度到细粒度逐层深化的问题层级。在解释阶段，可通过用浅层对齐问题替代深层具体问题，显著减少人类需审阅的问题数量，从而提升可解释性并保持任务性能。实验结果表明，当可用问题数量有限时，浅层问题即使数量相同也往往比深层问题表现出更高的任务性能，揭示了问题层级深度与性能之间的非线性关系，为高效设计可解释的文本嵌入提供了关键方法论支持。
