Abstract:Confidence estimates guide human review in LLM-built knowledge graphs, but better error prediction can yield little improvement in an audit. We study this gap through repairability, selection headroom and label validity. Modelling non-adaptive auditing as budgeted covering, we characterise the minimal decision-relevant error statistics and bound the regret of scalar-preserving first-order planning by a structural mass \Delta^\mathrmcl . We simulate ideal repair against benchmark-aligned labels for five extraction configurations and two cross-document graphs on Re-DocRED, followed by frozen confirmation on test and replication on 500 hash-selected training documents. On the held-out cross-document graphs, an error-rate \times fan-out queue leaves 3.98-4.74 percentage points more errors than a joint model with the same actions. By comparison, opening shared actions for that joint planner reduces residual errors by 0.89-1.43 points relative to its own fact-only plans, in point estimates. Equivalence between joint and independent-block models remains inconclusive. Generic LLM verification improves three of four model-budget configurations on each held-out set. LLM adjudication identifies possible benchmark omissions.

[NLP-55] CARTBench: Rubric-Based Evaluation of Shopping Advice for Complex and Ambiguous Requests with Timelines

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）购物助手在多轮对话中进行商品推荐时面临的评估难题，具体表现为数据稀缺性与评价标准难以统一。为应对这一挑战，研究提出CARTBench评测基准，聚焦于具有时间线的复杂且模糊的购物请求（Complex and Ambiguous Requests with Timelines, CART）。针对数据稀缺问题，研究团队从17个零售领域的真实商业需求中收集案例，构建了包含1603条商品记录与带时间戳对话的数据集；针对评价标准不统一的问题，基于成功订单中人工精选的优质回复提炼出“理想回应原则”（Ideal Response Principles），并据此制定案例定制化的评分细则，同时设计了基于原则引导的结构化推荐策略——Principle-Guided CART Prompting。实验评测涵盖1328项由专家标注的评估维度，覆盖核心能力、卓越表现与安全性三个层面。对7款主流商业API模型（包括GPT-6.1-Sol和Claude-Opus-5）及350亿参数以上开源模型的全面评估表明，在冻结评分规则下，仅有3款模型在核心能力上超过90%，而无一模型在卓越性指标上突破45%。这揭示了当前模型在理解需求与高质量执行之间存在显著“理解-执行鸿沟”。进一步诊断发现，模型失败主要源于对产品证据的识别不足以及未解决的需求遗留问题，其根源在于动态变化的需求与关键未知信息的不确定性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05862
作者: Yuqin Dai,Zhanwei Zhang,Honghui Yang,Zhouheng Yao,Yueqi Zhang,Jingyu He,Chaoyang Shi,Fanding Wei,Boyuan Pan,Kai Xu,Yao Hu,Yongliang Shen
机构: Tsinghua University(清华大学); Xiaohongshu Inc.(小红书); Shanghai Jiao Tong University(上海交通大学); Zhejiang University(浙江大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language model (LLM) shopping assistants now recommend products in multi-turn conversations. However, reliable evaluation faces Data scarcity and Difficulty Standardizing Criteria. To address these obstacles, we introduce CARTBench for CART (Complex and Ambiguous Requests with Timelines). For Data scarcity, we curate cases from real commercial shopping needs across 17 retail domains, pairing timestamped dialogue with 1,603 product records. For Difficulty Standardizing Criteria, we develop case-specific rubrics guided by Ideal Response Principles, distilled from excellent replies manually selected from successfully completed orders. These principles also guide Principle-Guided CART Prompting, our structured recommendation strategy. The experimental benchmark contains 1,328 expert-annotated criteria across Core, Excellence, and Safety. To answer the CART question, we evaluate 7 flagship commercial API models, including GPT-6.1-Sol and Claude-Opus-5, and 35B+ parameters open-weight models. In the first full-suite evaluation under the frozen rubrics, 3 of 10 models exceed 90% on Core, while none exceeds 45% on Excellence. Therefore, we identify an understanding-to-execution gap between required behavior and high-quality purchase advice. To examine these limitations, we diagnose shared failures in product evidence and unresolved needs, linked to changing requirements and decisive unknowns. Code and data are available at this https URL.

[NLP-56] andemBench: Benchmarking Decision Models for Multi-Agent Collaboration

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多智能体协作场景中决策模型在团队任务规划选择与最优性验证方面的局限性问题。其核心挑战在于：尽管现有决策模型能够从给定选项中选出看似合理的团队计划（team plan），但难以准确判断所供选项中是否已包含最优解，即存在系统性误判风险。解决方案的关键在于构建TandemBench这一基准数据集，包含1,200个基于多智能体烹饪场景的复杂协作任务，所有任务均基于完整全局信息和候选团队计划进行评估，并通过精确搜索与执行验证生成参考答案。通过设计成对测试（paired tests）——在保留或移除最优计划的两种情境下对比模型判断能力——揭示出当前主流决策模型虽在选择正确计划方面达到62.50%的准确率，但在最优性验证任务上表现接近随机水平，且部分模型会错误报告“存在更优方案”，即使已有最优计划被提供。这一发现表明，仅依赖团队计划选择的准确性无法反映模型在最优性判断上的真实能力，凸显了对决策模型进行更深层次合理性验证的重要性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05827
作者: Baohang Li,Xiaocheng Feng,Bing Qin
机构: Harbin Institute of Technology (哈尔滨工业大学); Peng Cheng Laboratory (鹏城实验室)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Decision models choose among predefined options in tasks such as routing and action selection. In multi-agent collaboration, a decision determines how members divide work, exchange resources, and act in parallel. We introduce TandemBench, a benchmark of 1,200 questions in multi-agent cooking scenarios where coordination choices affect goal completion. Models receive complete global information and candidate team plans, with reference answers established through execution and exact search. Models select an optimal team plan and, in paired variants that retain or remove it, judge whether better arrangements exist beyond the supplied options. We evaluate 40 native decision models and compare them with 10 general-purpose language models. The best native decision model achieves 62.50% decision accuracy. Native decision models remain close to chance in optimality verification. Paired tests reveal that some report better alternatives regardless of whether an optimal plan is already present. These findings show that team-plan decision accuracy alone can conceal systematic errors in judging whether the supplied options contain an optimal arrangement. The dataset and evaluation code are publicly available at this https URL.

[NLP-57] Learning When Human Decisions Matter: Executor-Relative Consultation Value for LLM Agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在大型语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）执行复杂任务时，如何高效分配有限的人类决策资源（human decision capacity）的问题。核心挑战在于：人类输入的咨询价值具有执行器依赖性（executor-dependent），即同一人类反馈对不同下游代理的增益存在差异，因此需动态评估每项决策的咨询价值以实现最优资源配置。其解决方案的关键是提出一种离线式咨询价值蒸馏（Consultation Value Distillation, CVD）方法，通过蒙特卡洛执行器回溯（Monte Carlo executor rollouts）在训练阶段预估咨询价值，并将这些价值知识蒸馏为轻量级预测器，从而在部署阶段无需依赖实时回溯即可进行预算约束下的近似最优咨询决策。CVD通过联合建模与延续感知（continuation-aware）的价值学习机制，显著提升了多轮和批量场景下的分配性能，在多个前沿执行器设置中优于独立咨询价值估计、直接提示（direct prompting）及信息价值（Value of Information）等基线方法，同时具备更强的鲁棒性与更低的回溯监督成本，实现了近乎无损的低开销近似分配。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05814
作者: Shuli Jiang,Khushbu Pahwa,Yuting Zhang,Yi Zhang,Wei Xia,Stefano Soatto
机构: Amazon(亚马逊); AWS Agentic AI(亚马逊网络服务代理人工智能)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 31 pages, 20 tables, 2 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models increasingly automate complex tasks, but human decision capacity does not scale with their capabilities. In many applications, humans remain essential for providing private context, authority, or judgments unavailable to the agent. We formulate human decision capacity allocation: given multiple consultation opportunities and a limited budget, at which decisions should an LLM agent consult a human? The central challenge is estimating consultation value, which is executor-dependent because the same human input may benefit different downstream agents differently. We introduce Consultation Value Distillation (CVD), which estimates consultation values offline using Monte Carlo executor rollouts and distills these values into lightweight predictors for budgeted allocation, requiring no rollout-based value estimation at deployment. Across five batch and three sequential settings with two frontier executors, CVD improves allocation through joint and continuation-aware value learning, while independent consultation values remain competitive in several settings. CVD also broadly outperforms direct prompting and Value of Information where applicable, remains robust with substantially less rollout supervision, and enables nearly lossless approximate allocation at low search cost.

[NLP-58] Matching the Training-Time Weight Rule in Inference-Time Expert Deactivation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在推理阶段进行专家（expert）去激活时，由于令牌路由策略与专家权重更新规则不匹配所导致的模型性能下降问题。其核心挑战在于：专家去激活不仅影响令牌的路由路径，还会改变专家权重分布，而这些变化对模型表现的影响高度依赖于训练阶段所采用的权重更新规则（如归一化或非归一化）。论文的关键解决方案是提出一个加权求和模型（weight-sum model），用于量化分析训练阶段的权重规则如何影响专家贡献损失与分支尺度变化，并据此预测不同去激活策略下的性能表现。实验结果表明，在使用原始路由器概率训练的模型中，保留专家重归一化（remaining-expert renormalization）能获得最佳困惑度；而在使用归一化权重训练的模型中，非归一化重路由（unnormalized re-routing）表现更优。当训练规则与推理策略不一致时，困惑度可恶化达28,740倍，且任务表现显著退化——例如在OLMoE上，GSM8K严格匹配准确率降至零。此外，实验还验证了随着活跃专家数量减少，额外的重归一化带来的困惑度惩罚呈上升趋势，揭示了专家稀疏性与模型稳定性之间的关键权衡。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05804
作者: Hao Cheng(Zhejiang Gongshang University),Zhiyu Yang(Chang’an University),Bo Ma(Zhejiang Gongshang University),Hanzhang Jia(University of Sussex)
机构: Zhejiang Gongshang University(浙江工商大学); Chang’an University(长安大学); University of Sussex(萨塞克斯大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: Corresponding authors: Hanzhang Jia (lead corresponding) and Bo Ma

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Expert deactivation at inference time changes both token routing and expert weights, and its effect on performance depends on how these changes are implemented. We compare removal, freezing, remaining-expert renormalization, and unnormalized re-routing on identical disabled sets across five instruction-tuned checkpoints from four model families, with a base OLMoE checkpoint as an additional comparison. We develop a weight-sum model that relates the loss of expert contributions and changes in branch scale to the weight rule used during training. With half of the experts deactivated according to activation-based rankings, remaining-expert renormalization yields the highest perplexity in models trained with raw router probabilities, whereas unnormalized re-routing yields the highest perplexity in models trained with normalized weights. Perplexity ranges from 1.4 to 73 times the intact baseline when the training rule is retained, and from 14 to 28,740 times the baseline under a rule mismatch. Task outcomes vary across evaluation types: on OLMoE, GSM8K strict-match accuracy falls to zero under all four implementations. Extending the model to changes in the number of active experts yields a further prediction, supported by the OLMoE experiments: the perplexity penalty from additional renormalization increases as fewer experts are activated.

[NLP-59] Phonological Knowledge of Chinese Characters in Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在探究语言模型（Language Models, LMs）对汉字的语音知识掌握程度及其表征与使用机制，尤其关注汉语中声母、韵母、声调及多音字等语音特征的理解能力。其核心问题是：当前主流文本仅输入的语言模型在处理汉字语音信息时，究竟具备何种层次的语音知识？解决方案的关键在于构建一个受控基准测试集——PinyinBench，涵盖同音字、语音特征（声母、韵母、声调）以及多音字，并采用行为评估、层间探针分析和激活操控三种互补方法进行综合考察。研究发现，模型在声母与韵母信息上表现出较强的表征能力，且可通过深度网络逐步增强；而声调信息虽在嵌入层可被有效解码，但其在生成过程中的可操控性较弱，表明声调表征难以通过因果干预有效影响输出。此外，引入音频模态训练虽提升了语音特征的可解码性，却未显著改善其操控效果。这一结果揭示了音段信息与声调信息在模型内部表征与功能上的本质差异，凸显了结合行为表现、探针分析与因果干预多维度评估语言模型语言知识的必要性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05803
作者: Xiaozhe Ji,Renfen Hu,Hai Hu
机构: Beijing Normal University (北京师范大学); The Hong Kong Polytechnic University (香港理工大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 17 pages, 11 figures, 10 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:How much phonological knowledge do language models (LMs) possess about Chinese characters, and how is this knowledge represented and used? We introduce PinyinBench, a controlled benchmark covering homophones, phonological features (initials, finals, and tones), and polyphonic characters. We investigate 17 text-only and multimodal LMs through three complementary approaches: behavioral evaluation, layer-wise probing, and activation steering. Behaviorally, models demonstrate substantial knowledge of initials and finals, with a frontier model (DS-v4-flash) scoring 90%+ in homophone judgment, when two characters share no phonological features. However, its accuracy drops sharply to 72% when two characters differ only in lexical tone. Probing reveals that tone is highly decodable from embeddings and improves modestly across layers, whereas segmental information starts less decodable and improves substantially with depth. Activation steering shows that segmental representations can systematically influence generation, while tone exhibits much weaker effects. Furthermore, audio-bearing training improves phonological decodability, including tone, without corresponding improvements in steering effectiveness. Together, these findings reveal distinct representational and functional profiles for segmental and tonal information, with tonal information much harder to access and manipulate, demonstrating the necessity for combined evaluation, probing, and causal intervention for understanding linguistic knowledge in LMs.

[NLP-60] How Well Can Large Language Models Impersonate Individual Authors? A Comparative Evaluation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在文本生成中对特定作者写作风格的模仿能力问题，尤其是识别其是否能够实现真正的风格拟合而非简单地复制训练数据。研究聚焦于六种主流大语言模型（Gemini 3 Pro、Claude Opus、GPT 5.2、GPT 5.2 Pro、DeepSeek 3.2 和 Grok 4.1 Fast）在短产品评论文本上的作者身份伪装能力，采用基于余弦距离的嵌入相似性度量与嵌入分布可视化相结合的方法进行评估。关键发现在于：尽管 Gemini 3 Pro 在表面模仿性能上表现最优，但其实际表现为大量重复和复用训练语料中的句子与短语，远超人类作者水平；进一步的因子分析表明，训练集一致性是预测模仿成功的关键因素，而作者独特性则无法作为可靠预测指标。此外，全局嵌入空间可视化揭示多数模型生成文本位于与目标人类作者集群明显分离的区域，反映出模型存在固有的词汇与短语偏好，难以真正收敛至目标作者风格。因此，该研究的核心解决方案在于提出区分“真实风格模仿”与“直接文本复用”的判别框架，为涉及大语言模型潜在伪造行为的文本司法鉴定提供了重要方法论启示。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05771
作者: Harshit Gupta,Shunichi Ishihara
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:This study investigates the authorship impersonation capacity of six widely used large language models (LLMs): Gemini 3 Pro, Claude Opus, GPT 5.2, GPT 5.2 Pro, DeepSeek 3.2, and Grok 4.1 Fast. The evaluation was conducted using short product review texts selected to ensure high within author consistency in individual writing style. Two types of in context prompt were designed: a simple prompt with minimal instruction and a complex prompt incorporating explicit stylometric guidance for mimicry. Authorship mimicry was evaluated using a cosine distance based distance to training metric, supplemented by visual analyses of embedding distributions. The results indicate that authorship impersonation remained challenging for most LLMs, with Gemini 3 Pro showing the strongest apparent mimicry performance. However, subsequent overlap analysis revealed that Gemini 3 Pro extensively copied and reused sentences and phrases from the training texts, at levels far exceeding those observed among human authors. Follow up factor analyses showed that training set consistency was the most robust predictor of mimicry success across models, whereas author distinctiveness did not generalise as a reliable predictor. Global embedding visualisations further revealed a consistent macro level pattern: for most models, generated texts occupied regions of the embedding space that were largely separated from the corresponding human training clusters. This indicates limited convergence towards target author style and suggests the presence of model specific lexical and phraseological preferences. The findings highlight the importance of distinguishing genuine stylistic imitation from direct textual reuse and have implications for the forensic analysis of textual evidence involving potential LLM enabled impersonation.

[NLP-61] PAYWORTHY: Can LLM s Predict Which Freelance Jobs an AI Agent Will Complete?

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在生成式 AI (Generative AI) 代理执行付费任务前，如何有效评估其成功可能性的问题。现有机制缺乏对AI代理胜任力的可靠预判能力，导致难以实现高效的任务分配与信任建立。其核心解决方案是提出PAYWORTHY数据集，包含1,494个真实自由职业岗位（从2020至2026年间平台发布的1880万条岗位中采样），并通过让大型语言模型（LLM）作为客户裁判，在单次运行中评估由不同描述的AI代理尝试任务后的成功率。研究发现：当明确告知代理的能力限制时，18个测试模型均能显著优于随机排序地预测成功任务（AUC达0.66–0.86）；而若仅将代理描述为具备通用浏览器与代码执行能力的“通用代理”，则所有模型的预测表现退化至接近随机水平（AUC 0.45–0.56）。这一结果在四类其他模型家族（Claude、GLM、Kimi、Qwen）及两名人类评判者中均具稳健性，表明模型的判断能力高度依赖于对代理能力边界的明确认知。关键结论在于：准确评估生成式AI代理的胜任力，前提是提供清晰、具体的能力边界信息，而非模糊的“通用”设定。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05759
作者: Mohammad Reza Rezaei,Dingxian Wang,Brett Levert,Celeste Fejzo,Andrew Rabinovich,Zhao Chen
机构: Upwork Inc.(Upwork公司)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Before an AI agent takes on a paid job, someone has to judge whether it is likely to succeed. We test whether frontier language models can make this call before any attempt. We propose PAYWORTHY which contains 1,494 real freelance job postings, sampled from 18.8M postings made between 2020 and 2026 on a freelancing platform. An agent attempts each job from the posting alone in a single run, and an LLM judge acting as the client decides whether to accept the work. We ask 18 models to forecast how likely the agent is to succeed and measure how well each model’s forecasts rank the accepted jobs above the rejected ones (AUC, where 0.5 is a random ranking). The answer depends on how the agent is described. Told what the agent cannot do, every model ranks the jobs well (AUC 0.66–0.86). Told instead that it is a generic agent with a browser and code execution, the same models rank the same jobs about as well as a random ordering (0.45–0.56). These results hold under judges from four other model families (Claude, GLM, Kimi and Qwen), and the informed forecasts also rank the verdicts of two human raters. [NLP-62] xt-Only Domain Adaptation for Low-Resource Medical ASR: Shallow Fusion and Density Ratio Rescoring for Hausa

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决低资源语言（如豪萨语）在医疗领域中自动语音识别（ASR）性能不佳的问题，尤其针对医疗专有词汇识别困难的挑战。其核心问题在于缺乏足够的领域特定语音数据，导致现有模型难以有效捕捉医疗语境下的语言特征。解决方案的关键在于采用轻量级、仅依赖文本的语言模型融合策略，利用固定声学模型（MMS-1B-FL102）结合两种解码时语言模型融合方法——浅层融合（Shallow Fusion, SF）与密度比法（Density Ratio Approach, DRA），通过在通用领域语言模型基础上引入医疗领域文本训练的4-gram语言模型（KenLM），实现对医疗术语的增强建模。实验结果表明，两种融合方法均显著降低词错误率（WER），分别降至23.55%和23.33%，优于贪婪解码（p < 0.001），且二者差异不显著（p = 0.423）。尽管医疗语言模型带来一定改进，但相较于通用语言模型，其增益有限，且在医疗术语错误率方面未展现出明显优势。研究证明，无需额外收集领域语音数据，仅通过文本层面的语言模型融合即可有效提升豪萨语医疗ASR性能。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05744
作者: Oche David Ankeli,Hassan Adelani Luqman,Theodora Ngozi Egbunike,Joshua Gottschalk,Bonaventure F. P. Dossou
机构: RUZIVO Research Lab, African Leadership University, Kigali, Rwanda; Stanford University, Stanford, CA, USA; Mila – Quebec AI Institute and McGill University, Montreal, Canada
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems often struggle with specialised medical vocabulary, especially in low-resource languages where domain-specific speech data are scarce. We investigate text-only domain adaptation for Hausa medical ASR using the fixed MMS-1B-FL102 acoustic model and two decoding-time language-model fusion methods: Shallow Fusion (SF) and the Density Ratio Approach (DRA). A 4-gram KenLM trained on 19,421 Hausa health sentences serves as the medical target model, while a 75,372-sentence general-domain model provides the source prior for DRA. Evaluation uses 250 recordings of 25 physician-reviewed prompts from 10 speakers across six northern Nigerian states. Under prompt-disjoint five-fold cross-validation, SF and DRA reduce WER from 29.56% to 23.55% and 23.33%, respectively. Both significantly outperform greedy decoding (p 0.001), while their difference is not significant (p = 0.423). However, general-LM-only SF achieves 23.96% WER, indicating that the medical LM’s additional improvement over a general LM is modest. Medical Term Error Rate also improves under fusion, but does not establish a distinct medical-domain advantage. These findings demonstrate that lightweight, text-only language-model fusion can improve Hausa medical ASR without additional domain-specific speech collection.

[NLP-63] Prospective Memory for Proactive LLM Agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）智能体在执行前瞻性任务时缺乏有效未来导向记忆机制的问题。现有记忆系统多为回溯性记忆，仅能存储和调用过往信息以支持当前决策，而无法有效维持并适时实现未来意图。其核心挑战在于：即使正确记住未来目标，也未必能在恰当的时机采取行动——某些情境可能需要延迟响应，而后续线索才真正触发执行条件。为此，论文提出Pro-Memory框架，其关键创新在于将“保持未来意图”与“决定何时何地实施”进行解耦。该框架通过保留意图及其支撑证据，并基于原始目标与激活条件动态评估新观测，从而判断是否应采取行动；同时，它根据实际执行行为或完成状态更新意图状态，并利用经验记忆从已完成任务中提炼反馈，指导未来决策。实验结果表明，Pro-Memory在延迟意图任务和开放式主动辅助任务两个基准上，相较于多种代表性记忆方法，在不同LLM模型架构下均显著提升了前瞻性任务表现，且有效减少了不必要的干预。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05731
作者: Yuanchen Bei,Zhining Liu,Tianxin Wei,Weizhi Zhang,Zhichen Zeng,Philip S. Yu,Hendrik Hamann,Jingrui He,Hanghang Tong
机构: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign(伊利诺伊大学厄本那-香槟分校); University of Illinois Chicago(伊利诺伊大学芝加哥分校); Stony Brook University(石溪大学); Brookhaven National Laboratory(布鲁克海文国家实验室)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 17 pages, 8 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Most memory systems for LLM agents are retrospective, preserving and retrieving past information to inform current decisions. Proactive agents, however, also require prospective memory: retaining future-directed intentions and realizing them when appropriate opportunities arise, even without explicit requests. Crucially, remembering the right intention does not guarantee acting at the right time: a related observation may call for waiting, while a later cue may make the same intention actionable. Inspired by cognitive theories of human prospective memory, we introduce Pro-Memory, a memory framework that separates maintaining future intentions from deciding when and how to realize them. Pro-Memory preserves pending objectives linked to their supporting evidence, assesses new observations against their original goals and activation conditions, and coordinates appropriate contributions with the agent’s ongoing actions. It further updates intention states based on actions actually issued or evidence of resolution, while an experience memory distills feedback from completed episodes into guidance for future decisions. Experiments on two benchmarks spanning delayed-intention tasks and open-ended proactive assistance demonstrate consistent improvements in proactive task performance over representative memory approaches across multiple LLM backbones, while limiting unnecessary interventions.

[NLP-64] Cognitive Bias Signatures in Search-Equipped LLM Agents : A Stage-Resolved Analysis

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）代理在搜索过程中因初始条件偏差而导致错误修正能力受限的问题，特别是探究初始证据顺序、先前工作记录及初始假设等因素如何影响其检索与决策过程。其解决方案的关键在于构建一个受控的搜索范式（controlled search harness），在固定问题和文档集合的前提下，系统性地操纵结果顺序、历史轨迹和初始假设，从而分离出各因素对最终答案的影响。研究通过10个模型在1000个合成搜索环境中的多维度追踪（包括查询、检索文档、文档打开行为及最终答案），发现最终答案对主动搜索中初始证据顺序更为敏感，且错误路径的历史记录会抑制策略切换，这种影响超出上下文长度的范畴；此外，在错误假设下，阶段测量可区分检索/打开不足与在反证出现后仍持续错误的情况。探索性干预表明，频繁打开反证未必提升准确率，而适度增加反证访问即可显著改善表现，揭示了优化信息获取策略的关键在于精准引导而非简单增加暴露频率。

Abstract:Search can help LLM agents correct mistakes, but their starting conditions may shape which evidence they find and use. Drawing on cognitive-bias paradigms, we develop a controlled search harness to examine result order, records of prior work, and initial hypotheses while holding each question and document collection fixed. Matched controls distinguish order effects from differences in document composition and the effects of failed work from context length. Across 10 models and 1,000 synthetic search worlds, we track queries, retrieved documents, document openings, and final answers. Our comparisons suggest that final answers are more sensitive to initial evidence order during active search than when all evidence is supplied in full. Dead-end histories can reduce strategy switching relative to matched neutral histories, indicating an effect beyond context length. Under wrong hypotheses, stage measurements distinguish reduced retrieval or opening from errors that persist after counter-evidence is opened. Exploratory interventions show that opening counter-evidence more often can coincide with lower accuracy, while accuracy can improve with little change in opening.

[NLP-65] Grounded but Not Immune: Confirmation Bias in Agent -as-a-judge

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI 代理在开放性任务评估中因“代理作为裁判”（Agent-as-a-Judge）机制所引发的确认偏误（confirmation bias）问题。其核心挑战在于，尽管裁判代理能够自主收集决定性证据以验证结果，但其判断仍可能被无关的、虚假的预筛选提示（pre-screening note）所误导，导致高达40%的正确结论被错误翻转。解决方案的关键在于识别并分类确认偏误对代理行为轨迹的影响，揭示其本质为三种失败模式：过度信任（over-trust，即在正确验证后仍盲目服从外部提示）、幻觉（hallucination，即虚构支持性证据以支持翻转结论）以及调查不足（under-investigation，即在首次出现符合提示的信号时即停止深入探究）。研究发现，大型代理如Claude主要表现为过度信任（占有害翻转的67%-75%），而小型代理则三类错误模式分布较均。尽管采用轻量级缓解措施可部分削弱偏误，但无法彻底消除。该工作通过将外部提示视为受控诊断工具而非对抗攻击，系统性地揭示了确认偏误如何在代理决策过程中逐步侵蚀其判断可靠性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05662
作者: Drake Benjamin Brown,Khushbu Pahwa,Yubin Ge,Salvatore Romeo,Akhil Agnihotri,Yi Zhang,Xiaofei Ma,Daniele Bonadiman
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)

Abstract:Evaluating open-ended agent tasks increasingly falls to an Agent-as-a-Judge: an evaluator handed tools and the agent’s full trajectory so it can verify a result against the environment. The premise is that a judge that gathers its own evidence should be grounded by it. We show that this grounding does not immunize the judge against confirmation bias: a single false pre-screening note, attributed to an authority and carrying no evidential bearing on the correct verdict, overturns up to 40% of a tool-using judge’s correct verdicts across four judges and five datasets, even though the judge collects decisive evidence. The shift is driven by specific properties of the cue. We treat this cue as a controlled diagnostic of confirmation bias rather than an adversarial attack. Our central contribution is to explain how confirmation bias changes the judge’s behavior in a trajectory. We classify changes in judge behavior and attribute changes to one of three failure modes: over-trust (verify, conclude correctly, then defer), hallucination (fabricate support for the flip), and under-investigation (stop at the first corroborating signal). For the two Claude judges, the failure is predominantly over-trust (67-75% of harmful flips), while smaller judges have error modes spread across all three. Lightweight mitigations blunt but never remove the bias.

[NLP-66] AGORA: Reliability-Aware Aggregation of LLM Judges via Item-Response Theory

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型作为评判者（LLM-as-a-judge）在人工评估中因评判者可靠性差异显著而产生的偏差问题，尤其针对小规模标注数据集下传统聚合方法（如Dawid-Skene模型）因样本不足导致的误差估计不准确与权重分配失衡的问题。其解决方案的关键在于提出AGORA（Aggregation Of Reliability-weighted Assessments），一种基于项目反应理论（Item Response Theory, IRT）的无监督聚合框架：该方法将所有评价项目置于单一潜在质量维度上，通过为每位评判者学习一个敏感度参数和有序的评分阈值，实现对评判者可靠性的联合建模，无需依赖人工标注标签即可自动推断评判者信任权重。实验表明，在三个基准测试中，AGORA在大规模评估集上性能不低于甚至优于Dawid-Skene，在数据量缩减至数百项时优势更为明显；同时，其对评判者池分布不均具有更强鲁棒性，且可通过无标签的离散度统计量提前判断信任加权的有效性，其学习得到的信任权重亦能有效反映评判者的实际人类有效性。

作者: Junhyung Ahn
机构: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (伊利诺伊大学厄本那-香槟分校)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:LLM-as-a-judge is a common substitute for costly human evaluation, and aggregating several judges is the standard remedy for any single judge’s bias. Judge pools mix judges of very different reliability, while the human-labeled sets that validate them hold a few hundred items or fewer. In this regime the per-item mean weights weak judges as heavily as strong ones, and confusion-table models such as Dawid-Skene must estimate a per-judge error table from too few items. We propose AGORA (Aggregation Of Reliability-weighted Assessments), an item-response-theory aggregator that places every item on one latent quality scale and describes each judge by a sensitivity parameter and ordered rating thresholds, so judge reliability is learned from all items jointly and without human labels. Across three benchmarks, AGORA matches or exceeds Dawid-Skene on large evaluation sets, and its advantage widens as the set shrinks toward a few hundred items. It remains accurate as pools grow more uneven, a label-free dispersion statistic indicates in advance when trust weighting helps, and its learned trust weights track per-judge human validity.

[NLP-67] Iterated creation grading and revision of data science projects by language models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式AI在端到端数据科学项目中的自主执行能力及其在反馈机制下的性能提升问题。核心挑战在于评估不同模型在无外部干预情况下完成数据获取、清洗、分析及撰写研究报告等完整流程的能力，并探究反馈循环对最终成果质量的影响。其解决方案的关键在于构建一个“写作者-评分者”双角色闭环系统：由具备特定工具调用能力的“写作者”模型独立完成数据科学项目，再由另一模型或同一模型作为“评分者”进行评估，随后根据反馈迭代优化，共进行三轮循环。实验覆盖七种来自五大开发者的模型（Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、DeepSeek等），形成49个写作者-评分者组合，每组运行三次。结果显示，初始平均得分从59%提升至76%，表明反馈显著改善了项目质量；但提升幅度高度依赖角色分工，其中弱模型难以通过反馈有效提升强模型的表现，且自评得分普遍比其他模型平均分高出约9个百分点，反映出评分者自身评估偏差的存在。此外，即使无具体反馈仅提供修订机会或增加资源预算，部分模型仍实现显著改进，说明过程灵活性与资源投入亦是关键因素。

Abstract:We evaluate the extent to which agentic AI models can complete an end-to-end data science project, and how this improves with feedback. A ‘writer’ model with specific tools creates a complete data science project including downloading, cleaning, and analyzing a dataset, and writing a short paper about it. The project is executed and a ‘grader’ model evaluates it. The writer can then revise its submission, and this repeats for a total of three rounds. We consider seven models from five developers: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, and this http URL. Each model is both a writer and a grader, so there are 49 writer-grader pairs and we run each pair three times. Of the 147 initial submissions, 107 run and render, and the average score increases from 59 per cent to 76 per cent after the final round of feedback. By writer the extent of the increase ranges from 3 percentage points for Anthropic’s Opus 5.5 to 46 percentage points for Anthropic’s Haiku 4.5, and by grader it ranges from 13 percentage points for Google’s Gemini 3.8 Flash to 32 percentage points for Anthropic’s Haiku 4.5. When a model grades its own writing the score tends to be about 9 percentage points higher than the average of what the other models give it. About half of the difference that we see from round to round is within the grader’s own noise. Feedback generally results in the highest marks, but even just having the chance to revise, or having the additional budget, in terms of time or tool calls, without any feedback, results in considerable increases for some of the models but not for others. We find that how much such a loop helps depends on which model plays which role, but weaker models generally do not improve stronger models.

[NLP-68] Rewrite Then Veto: Rewriter-Agnostic Edit Gating for LLM -Based Post-OCR Correction

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）在修复历史文献光学字符识别（OCR）文本时存在的过度修正问题：尽管LLM能够有效纠正错误的OCR输出，但其在处理原本正确的文本时也会引入新的错误。为应对这一问题，作者提出EditVeto——一种置于全上下文LLM重写之后的“否决门”机制。该方案的核心在于：将模型的重写结果与原始OCR输入进行字符级对齐，将差异划分为若干块，并通过一个0.6B参数量的小型门控网络决定每个块是否保留或回滚。关键创新点在于，基于“真实错误位置”的模拟分析表明，对每个片段独立生成修正反而比不修正更差，而对整个重写结果的编辑进行整体否决则显著提升性能。该门控机制在两个Qwen3模型生成的重写数据上训练，并在八个HIPE-OCRepair-2026测试集上冻结评估，结果显示其在所有五种重写器（包括两种未参与训练的）上均取得改进，加权字符错误率（cMER）降低0.0026–0.0044，偏好得分提升0.15–0.25（配对bootstrap检验，p≈0.0002）。在公开竞赛结果上的表现进一步验证了其有效性，虽使获胜团队的cMER略有上升（0.0050 → 0.0065），但对其他三支队伍均有改善。二次披露测试中，重新训练的门控仍能提升LoRA微调重写器的表现（cMER下降0.0011至0.0021），且多模型门控编辑的集成结果达到cMER 0.0069、偏好得分0.928，主要得益于微调与集成策略而非门控本身。该系统仅依赖公开模型与数据，最终性能仅次于唯一采用领域预训练的冠军团队（cMER 0.0050），与第二名持平（cMER 0.0071），优于其余所有已发表结果。第三次独立评估显示，未调整的门控仍可提升零样本Qwen3.8-27B的性能（cMER从0.0114降至0.0108），并提升其LoRA微调版本的偏好得分。

Abstract:LLMs can repair noisy OCR transcripts of historical documents, but they also change text that was already correct. We propose EditVeto, a veto gate placed after a full-context LLM rewrite. The rewrite is character-aligned to the OCR input, its differences are split into blocks, and a 0.6B-parameter gate keeps or reverts each block. An oracle analysis motivates the design: given the true error locations, per-span generation is worse than no correction, whereas vetoing a full rewrite’s edits helps. Trained on rewrites by two Qwen3 models and evaluated, frozen, on the eight HIPE-OCRepair-2026 test sets, the gate improves all five rewriters tested, two of them unseen in training: weighted cMER falls by 0.0026-0.0044 and the preference score rises by 0.15-0.25 (paired bootstrap, p ~ 0.0002 each). On published competition outputs it lowers cMER for three of four teams but raises it for the winning run (0.0050 to 0.0065). In a second, disclosed test look, a retrained gate still improves LoRA-tuned rewriters (cMER -0.0011 to -0.0021), and an ensemble of their gated edits reaches a cMER of 0.0069 and a preference score of 0.928, mostly through fine-tuning and pooling rather than gating. Built only on public models and data, it is behind the winner (0.0050) and tied with the second-ranked run (0.0071), both from the only team using domain pre-training, and ahead of all other published runs. A third, secondary look shows the unchanged gate improving zero-shot Qwen3.8-27B (cMER 0.0114 to 0.0108) but only the preference score of its LoRA-tuned version.

[NLP-69] When to Ask When to Answer: Strategic Clarification for Ambiguous Reference Resolution in Dialogue

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在参考消歧任务中存在过早回答（premature answering）的问题，即模型倾向于在信息不充分时直接给出确定性答案，而非通过策略性提问来获取必要澄清信息。其核心挑战在于如何使模型在对话中具备“战略澄清”（strategic clarification）能力——即在提问时能够判断哪些问题能有效缩小候选指代对象的集合，从而提升消歧效率。解决方案的关键在于提出一种轻量级的动作选择方法BACE（Belief-Aware Critic with Epistemic tracking），该方法基于冻结的预训练语言模型主干，在推理过程中引入信念感知与认知状态追踪机制，动态评估当前知识不确定性，并据此决定是否提问或回答。实验表明，BACE相比GRPO和ArCHer等基线方法，能更一致地选择最优数量的澄清问题，显著提升了参考消歧的准确性和对话效率。

作者: Ibrahim Khebour,Nikhil Krishnaswamy
机构: Colorado State University (科罗拉多州立大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)

Abstract:For humans, referential disambiguation is a collaborative process involving clarification questions asked when they will meaningfully change the outcome. However, large language models (LLMs) have been shown to be biased toward premature answering, preferring definite single-turn responses over more clarification exchanges. In this paper, we study the problem of “strategic clarification” – asking clarification questions in a reference game when their answers will narrow the set of candidate referents. We construct a controlled test environment from the SIMMC 2.1 dataset that records how many questions each ambiguous reference needs to be successfully resolved, and examine how baseline LLM behavior and common post-training methods ask clarifying questions vs. attempt to answer the referent. We also propose BACE (Belief-Aware Critic with Epistemic tracking), a lightweight action chooser method on top of a frozen LM backbone, and show that BACE more consistently chooses the optimal number of clarifying questions than methods such as GRPO and ArCHer.

[NLP-70] SlackBench: Benchmarking Agents on Collaborative Projects Grounded in Real Code Repositories

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有评估基准在模拟真实知识工作场景方面的不足，特别是针对生成式AI代理（AI Agents）在复杂协作环境中执行任务的能力评估。传统基准多依赖合成数据或孤立任务，无法反映实际科研与工程协作中信息分散于对话、代码及动态决策中的多源异构特性。为应对这一挑战，论文提出SlackBench，一个基于真实学术研究项目隐私保护复现的基准测试平台，其核心在于构建包含多参与者对话、持续演化的项目决策以及与GitHub仓库和Google Docs相一致的代码变更的可复现环境。解决方案的关键在于设计一系列需联合推理通信内容与代码状态的任务，涵盖跨源智能搜索、对不可回答或前提错误问题的合理回避、目标导向摘要生成及长对话上下文推断等，要求代理具备识别关键信息、遍历对话线程、检查代码仓库状态并整合多源证据的能力。实验表明，当前前沿模型在该基准上的最佳表现约为80%，多数系统低于66%，揭示了现有代理在真实协作场景下仍存在显著提升空间。

Abstract:AI Agents are becoming digital coworkers that can browse the web, write code, run experiments, and assist humans over extended horizons. Yet existing benchmarks fall short of real knowledge work: many rely on synthetic data or isolated tasks, missing the complex, multi-party dynamics of collaborative projects, where critical information is scattered across conversations, code, and evolving decisions. Even simple workplace questions may require locating relevant channels and direct messages, recovering context from long discussions, inspecting repository state, reconciling stale or conflicting evidence, and synthesizing across sources. We introduce SlackBench, a benchmark for evaluating agents on realistic research and engineering workflows that require joint reasoning over workplace communication and evolving repository state. Grounded in privacy-preserving reenactments of real academic research projects, SlackBench provides reproducible environments with realistic multi-party dialogue, evolving decisions, and corresponding code changes grounded in GitHub repositories and Google Docs. It contains 140 queries spanning heterogeneous-source agentic search, abstention on unanswerable or false-premise questions, goal-directed summarization, and circumstance inference over long conversations. These tasks are not reducible to static corpus question answering: agents must determine which conversations matter, traverse threads, inspect repository state, and synthesize evidence across communication and code artifacts. Across 33 frontier models and agent harnesses, the best system scores around 80% and most agents score below 66%, highlighting substantial headroom for improvement. SlackBench thus provides an extensible framework for evaluating agents in collaborative work environments. The SlackBench dataset is available at this https URL . [NLP-71] Unlocking Turing Tensor Cores: A Measured Throughput Account of From-Scratch Pre-training on a Single 22G RTX 2080 Ti

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决NVIDIA RTX 2080 Ti（TU102）显卡在硬件层面虽配备第二代张量核心（Tensor Cores），但厂商通过驱动层限制了半精度（FP16）矩阵乘法的计算性能，导致实际可用张量吞吐量远低于硬件峰值的问题。其解决方案的关键在于通过一个内核模块（kernel module）在NVIDIA驱动绑定设备前，修改FP16速度选择寄存器（SS0=0x88888888, SS1=0x8）并释放ACR互斥锁（ACR mutex），从而解除驱动层面的性能限制。实验表明，该方法使cuBLAS FP16矩阵乘法吞吐量从55.7提升至91.4 TFLOPS（约1.6倍），在相同预训练协议下，不同规模的中文编码器-解码器模型在训练吞吐量上均获得显著提升：小模型（75.7M参数）稳定吞吐量提升11.8%（从6,480增至7,246 tok/s），壁时减少9.0%；超小模型（tiny tier）提升4.7%，壁时节省3.8%；更小模型（pico-micro）提升不足0.3%。关键发现为：解锁增益与矩阵规模正相关，对小模型及以上层级呈现明显提升，且该增益为纯吞吐量提升，不影响训练动态与最终模型质量（比特级一致或误差小于10⁻³）。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05419
作者: Dezhou Shen
机构: 独立研究者(Independent Researcher)
类目: Hardware Architecture (cs.AR); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Distributed, Parallel, and Cluster Computing (cs.DC); Performance (cs.PF)
备注: 7 pages, 4 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The RTX 2080 Ti (TU102) ships full second-generation Tensor Cores in hardware, yet the vendor throttles FP16 matrix multiplication at the driver level, leaving usable tensor throughput well below the hardware peak. turing-unlock lifts this restriction with a kernel module that, before the nvidia driver binds the device, writes the FP16 speed selectors (SS0=0x88888888, SS1=0x8) and releases the ACR mutex; published measurements report cuBLAS FP16 matmul throughput rising from 55.7 to 91.4 TFLOPS (about 1.6x). On the same 22G 2080 Ti and under the same from-scratch pre-training protocol as the companion memory ledger (five tiers of Chinese encoder-decoder models, 2,451 steps per tier, 16,384 tokens per step, seed 42), we obtain a before/after throughput account: the small tier (75.7M parameters, 512-wide, 8+8 layers, activation checkpointing on) improves in steady-state throughput from 6,480 to 7,246 tok/s (+11.8%) with wall time cut from 1.77h to 1.61h (9.0% saved); the tiny tier goes from 15,150 to 15,866 tok/s (+4.7%) with wall time savings of 3.8%; the three smaller tiers (pico-micro) gain at most +0.3%; per-tier peak memory stays bit-identical, and final quality metrics are bit-identical or consistent within 10^-3. We conclude that the unlock gain is a function of matrix size, rising monotonically with tier – imperceptible for pico-micro, visible from tiny upward, and cashed out as a double-digit percentage at small – and that it is a pure throughput gain that leaves training dynamics untouched.

[NLP-72] Challenge-Aware Knowledge Recruitment with Meta-Agent Supervision for Medical Multi-Agent Reasoning

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在医学问答（Medical QA）中面对复杂推理任务时性能显著下降的问题，尤其针对现有基于多智能体辩论（multi-agent debate）的方法在处理高难度任务时难以超越单一模型提示（strong single-model prompting）的瓶颈。其核心挑战在于：当前系统在选择专家和检索知识时仅依赖初始问题信息，而忽视了推理过程中动态浮现的知识或能力缺口。为此，论文提出“挑战感知的自适应招募”（challenge-aware adaptive recruitment）机制，即引入一个外部挑战者（CHALLENGER）实时监控推理过程，识别出具体的事实性或专业性知识缺口，并据此触发针对性的知识检索或在讨论中引入特定领域的专家。实验结果表明，在MEDAGENTSBENCH硬子集上，预先检索几乎无益，而中间阶段的挑战感知检索显著提升性能；在多专家基线模型上，该方法在9个数据集中的8个实现准确率提升，相较仅使用挑战者的方案提高6个百分点。消融实验证明，检索时机与基于缺口的查询信号均具关键作用，且在真实网络搜索场景下，时间优势仍可保持。对于专家招募，自触发机制不可靠，而由挑战者触发的专家招募将GPT-4.1-mini MedQA准确率从46%提升至54%，并在所有泛化测试数据集上表现正向。然而，简单叠加检索与专家招募反而损害性能，凸显了协调多种自适应干预路径的重要性。研究结论表明，在多智能体医学推理系统设计中，“何时”与“为何”调用外部资源是决定性能的关键决策因素。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05393
作者: Riccardo Riccio,Haitz Sáez de Ocáriz Borde,Pietro Liò
机构: University of Cambridge(剑桥大学)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models perform strongly on standard medical QA but degrade on harder reasoning tasks, where multi-agent debate often fails to beat strong single-model prompting. We argue that a key limitation is that existing systems select experts and retrieve knowledge from the question alone, rather than from gaps that emerge during reasoning. We propose challenge-aware adaptive recruitment: an external CHALLENGER inspects the evolving reasoning trace and identifies specific factual or expertise gaps. These signals trigger targeted knowledge retrieval or mid-discussion specialist recruitment. On the MEDAGENTSBENCH hard subset (862 questions across nine biomedical datasets), upfront retrieval provides little benefit, while challenge-aware in-between retrieval performs better; on a multi-specialist backbone it improves accuracy on 8 of 9 datasets and adds 6 percentage points over Challenger Only. Ablations indicate benefits from both retrieval timing and gap-specific query signals, and a live web-search experiment shows that the timing advantage persists across retrieval backends. For specialist recruitment, self-triggered adaptation is unreliable, whereas Challenger-triggered recruitment raises GPT-4.1-mini MedQA accuracy from 46% to 54%, with positive direction on all tested generalization datasets. Naively combining retrieval and specialist recruitment degrades performance, highlighting the need to coordinate adaptive intervention channels. These results show that when and why external resources are recruited is a key design choice in multi-agent medical reasoning.

[NLP-73] Agent Harness Awareness: Turning Verified Telemetry into Operational Control for Tool-Using Agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决智能体在执行任务时存在的“操作性盲视”（operational blindness）问题，即工具描述虽能说明某动作的功能，却无法反映该动作在当前时刻是否健康或适宜执行。由于决策模型缺乏对运行时状态、监控数据、历史失败等关键信息的访问，导致其难以做出最优选择。其解决方案的核心在于提出“代理执行框架感知”（Agent Harness Awareness）这一信任分离的设计架构：由宿主在执行关键动作前提供一个小型、实时、经过验证的状态快照，同时保留测量、执行、评估与最终调度的控制权。实验结果表明，在多模型（GPT-5.6 Sol、Claude Sonnet 5、Gemini 3.7 Flash）和多种场景下的对比测试中，引入经验证的操作状态可使平均可观测策略遗憾降低96.9%，并将单次调度完成率从69.4%提升至95.8%；在端到端真实网络环境（含TCP/HTTP执行、OpenTelemetry追踪及故障注入）中，平均遗憾降至0毫秒（零额外可观测运行成本），且在9次故障案例中成功完成动作，远超无状态信息的对照组（5/9）。这证实了该架构在工具与网络层面显著提升了预调度决策质量，而运行时状态、硬件负载、经济性、重试自愈机制及异构选择等仍为该架构未来可拓展的实证方向。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05391
作者: Manu Agrawal,Shrey Nagpal
机构: Independent Researchers(独立研究员)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 9 pages, 3 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Tool descriptions tell an agent what an action can do, but they do not necessarily reveal whether that action is healthy or suitable at the moment of use. Execution harnesses often possess this information through monitors, traces, and recent failures while the model choosing the next action does not. We call this gap operational blindness. We introduce Agent Harness Awareness, a trust-separated design in which the host supplies a small, fresh, verified state snapshot before a consequential action while retaining measurement, enforcement, evaluation, and final dispatch authority. We test its tools-and-network instance with ToolRoute, a controlled isolation benchmark that holds the task and candidate semantics constant and varies the operational information available to the model. In a 216-decision ablation across GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Sonnet 5, and Gemini 3.7 Flash, verified tool-health state reduced mean observable policy regret by 96.9% against a same-shape neutral control (4,252 ms to 131 ms) and raised single-dispatch completion from 69.4% to 95.8%. In a separate 27-decision end-to-end replication with live local TCP/HTTP execution, OpenTelemetry client spans, and Toxiproxy-injected faults, verified state reduced mean regret from 8,956 ms to 0 ms (zero excess observable operational cost) and completed the live action in 9/9 model-by-fault cases versus 5/9 for the neutral control. These studies establish the tools-and-network instance of Agent Harness Awareness: selected host telemetry materially improves pre-dispatch operational choice. Runtime state, hardware pressure, economics, retry-aware recovery, and heterogeneous selection remain open empirical extensions of the same architecture.

[NLP-74] AI-Driven SaaS Platform Integration: AI Express for Unified Generative AI Services with Pay-As-You-Go Credit Systems and Scalable Microservice Architecture

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式AI（Generative AI）当前服务碎片化的问题，即文本生成、图像合成与代码辅助等功能需分别订阅，导致使用成本高昂且工作流频繁中断。其解决方案的关键在于推出一款统一的SaaS平台——AI Express，将多种AI能力整合为按使用量计费的一体化服务，通过单一接口提供包括核心代码审查（Core Code Reviewer）、文本转网站生成、脚本生成、语法检查、数据分析及水印去除在内的多项功能，用户无需具备技术背景即可便捷使用，从而实现高效、低成本且无缝衔接的AI应用体验。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05389
作者: Deepit Sapru
机构: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (伊利诺伊大学厄本那-香槟分校)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Software Engineering (cs.SE)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Generative AI is currently fragmented, with separate subscriptions required for text generation, image synthesis, and code assistance, leading to high costs and workflow disruptions. AI Express is a SaaS platform that consolidates these capabilities into a unified pay-as-you-go service. The platform provides a range of AI tools, including a Core Code Reviewer that evaluates GitHub repositories, a Text-to-Website generator that converts text into fully functional websites, script generation, grammar checking, data analysis, and watermark removal, all accessible through a single interface without requiring technical expertise.

[NLP-75] SRRM: A Retrieval-Reconstruction Benchmark for Evaluating Long-Context Memory in Small Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决小语言模型（Small Language Models, SLMs）在长上下文场景下信息保持能力不足且缺乏系统评估方法的问题。现有基准主要聚焦于检索任务，难以全面反映模型对长上下文记忆的完整保留能力。为此，本文提出一种轻量级、可完全复现的基准测试框架——目标检索与全局信息重建联合评估基准（Simple Retrieval-Reconstruction Memory, SRRM），并引入基准层面的度量指标“记忆保持率”（Memory Preservation Ratio, MPR），用于量化检索与重建性能之间的关联性。实验基于合成数据集，在三个Qwen2.5系列模型（0.5B、1.5B和3B参数量）上评估了10至100个事实陈述的上下文长度下的表现。结果表明，随着上下文长度增加，重建性能下降速度远快于检索准确率，说明仅依赖检索任务无法充分表征长上下文记忆保持能力。其中，Qwen2.5-1.5B在检索准确率（86.7%）、重建性能（45.7%）及MPR（0.53）上均优于更大的Qwen2.5-3B模型（分别为72.2%、18.5%和0.26），揭示参数量增大并不必然提升长上下文记忆保持能力。研究证明，SRRM能够系统化评估长上下文记忆，并揭示传统仅基于检索的评估框架所掩盖的互补性记忆行为。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05386
作者: Christopher Alberto Hamonangan
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 37 pages, 20 tables, 13 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Small Language Models (SLMs) are increasingly deployed on consumer-grade hardware, yet their ability to preserve information across progressively longer contexts remains insufficiently understood. Existing benchmarks primarily evaluate retrieval-oriented tasks, providing limited insight into whether successful retrieval reflects comprehensive long-context memory preservation. To address this limitation, this paper introduces Simple Retrieval-Reconstruction Memory (SRRM), a lightweight and fully reproducible benchmark that jointly evaluates Targeted Retrieval and Global Information Reconstruction. This study also proposes the Memory Preservation Ratio (MPR), a benchmark-level metric that quantifies the relationship between retrieval and reconstruction performance. SRRM was evaluated using a synthetic dataset on three Qwen2.5 models (0.5B, 1.5B, and 3B parameters) across context loads ranging from 10 to 100 factual statements. Experimental results show that reconstruction performance deteriorated substantially faster than retrieval accuracy as contextual information increased, indicating that retrieval alone is insufficient to characterize long-context memory preservation. Among the evaluated models, Qwen2.5-1.5B achieved the highest retrieval accuracy (86.7%), reconstruction performance (45.7%), and MPR (0.53), outperforming the larger Qwen2.5-3B model (72.2%, 18.5%, and 0.26, respectively). These findings demonstrate that increasing parameter count does not necessarily improve long-context memory preservation. Overall, SRRM provides a reproducible and extensible benchmark for systematically evaluating long-context memory while revealing complementary memory behaviors that remain hidden under retrieval-only evaluation frameworks.

[NLP-76] Same Origin Different Verdicts: Text Production Conditions Confound Machine-Generated Text Detection in Russian

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式文本检测中一个核心矛盾：文本的生成来源属于生产过程属性，而非可直接观测的文本特征，而自动化检测系统却需基于文本本身做出判断。其关键问题在于，不同检测方法在相同文本条件下得出的机器生成性评分存在显著不一致，这种不一致性可能源于数据收集、重复设计、格式化及预处理等非语义因素的影响。研究通过构建俄语语料库（1882份文档），包含由四种生成渠道（对应不同模型族）在3种任务模式下完成的45个任务的机器生成部分，以及经源归属层级标注的人类撰写部分，以控制生成来源不变，仅改变任务表述方式来考察外部条件对检测结果的影响。研究采用四种操作化指标进行测量：固定权重的可解释指数、训练好的分类器、基于开放模型的零样本度量和裁判模型。结果显示，四种方法间存在明显分歧——任务模式切换导致所有指标得分变化，其中三种呈现负向偏移，唯裁判模型呈正向偏移，且无一指标的置信区间覆盖零值。尽管在程序1结果后调整了比较方案与后续方法的具体设定，并修正了语料缺陷与嵌套验证偏差，分歧依然存在。此外，仅依赖源标识符的基线在13组划分中达到中位数AUROC=1.0000，且去除强调标记即可将原本确定的机器生成判别逆转为人类生成，而全文未作任何字符修改。这表明当前检测分数本质上是特定测量系统与语料特性共同作用的结果，反映的是数据采集、重复性、格式化及预处理决策，而非纯粹的语言风格或生成机制差异。因此，该研究揭示了现有生成式文本检测方法的脆弱性与不可靠性，其核心解决方案在于强调检测结果的高度情境依赖性，提示应重新审视检测系统的有效性边界与评估范式。

作者: Stanislav Kirichenko
机构: Independent Researcher
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 65 pages, 6 figures, 24 tables. English translation of the frozen Russian manuscript; the Russian text is the source of record and is available with all data, code and run manifests at this https URL (v1.0.1)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Automated detection of machine-generated text is applied where the verdict carries a cost for the author, yet origin is a property of the production process, not an observable property of the text. The conditions under which a text is produced push it in the same direction in which a generative model is presumed to push it. This study measures the contribution of these conditions while origin is held fixed. The Russian-language corpus of 1882 documents comprises a machine part, generated by four generation channels (each backed by its own model family) across 45 tasks in three task modes, and an archival human part annotated for source regimentation level before the texts were read. The primary contrast is computed within the machine corpus: both halves of a pair are generated by the same model for the same task and differ only in task wording. Machine-likeness is measured by four operationalisations: an interpretable index with weights fixed before data collection, a trained classifier, a zero-shot metric on an open model, a judge model. The main result is disagreement between procedures: changing the task mode shifted the scores of all four, but three gave a negative shift, the judge a positive one, and none of the four intervals covers zero. The comparison plan and the specifications of procedures 2-4 were fixed after the result of procedure 1, before procedures 2-4 ran; the disagreement survived correction of a corpus defect and of the nested validation. A baseline on the source identifier alone reaches a median AUROC of 1.0000 on the thirteen group splits where it is defined, and removing emphasis markers flipped a confident machine verdict to human without changing the full text by a single character. The scores are properties of a specific measurement system and corpus: they reflect data collection, repetition, formatting, and preprocessing decisions as well as linguistic style.

[NLP-77] Human-like cross-language generalisation in deep neural speaker embeddings and its acoustic foundations INTERSPEECH2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决深度神经网络中说话人嵌入（speaker embedding）在跨语言情境下的泛化能力问题，特别是其与人类感知及语音声学结构之间的一致性。研究通过对比粤语-英语双语语音在同语言与跨语言条件下的表现，利用18个先进的模型提取嵌入表示，并结合线性混合模型与表征相似性分析（representational similarity analysis），将模型生成的相似性度量与人类评分及声学特征进行比较。研究发现，说话人嵌入在跨语言情境下表现出良好的泛化能力，其模式与人类行为高度一致，能够准确区分说话人身份并对语言切换敏感。这种泛化能力主要依赖于跨语言共享的声学线索，并对特定语言的声学特征赋予差异化权重，呈现出与人类认知机制相类似的处理模式。因此，该研究的关键在于揭示了机器学习模型与人类在跨语言语音相似性判断上存在显著对齐，为生成式 AI 在跨语言语音识别中的可解释性与可靠性提供了有力证据。

作者: Tianze Xu,Xiyang Li,Xiaoming Jiang,Volker Dellwo
机构: University of Zurich (苏黎世大学); Shanghai International Studies University (上海外国语大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Sound (cs.SD); Audio and Speech Processing (eess.AS)
备注: This manuscript has been accepted for presentation at Interspeech 2026. Code is available at this https URL . The archived release is available on Zenodo at this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Generalisability is a central question for deep neural networks, including the cross-language generalisation of speaker embeddings. This study examined whether deep neural speaker embeddings generalise across languages and how such generalisation relates to human perception and acoustic structure. Using Cantonese–English bilingual speech presented in within- and cross-language conditions, we derived similarity from 18 state-of-the-art models and compared it with human ratings and acoustic features using linear mixed models and representational similarity analysis. Embeddings exhibited cross-language generalisation that broadly paralleled human behaviour, reflecting accurate identity discrimination and sensitivity to language switching. This generalisation relied on largely shared acoustic cues with language-sensitive weighting, mirroring human patterns. Together, these findings provide converging evidence for human–machine alignment in cross-language voice similarity processing.

[NLP-78] CCDWIKI: Decoupling Case Formulation from Response Generation in Longitudinal CBT Dialogue

Abstract:Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) demands more than empathic validation, requiring instead a structured formulation of the interplay among situations, automatic thoughts, emotions, and behaviors. Therapists formalize this interplay through a Cognitive Conceptualization Diagram, where maintaining longitudinal coherence necessitates continuous evidential adjudication to separate tentative hypotheses from established findings. Current dialogue systems track conversational history via retrieval or static profiles but lack the representational capacity to encode epistemic status. Consequently, provisional interpretations are often prematurely reified as established facts, inadvertently biasing downstream interventions. Addressing this limitation, CCDWiki is introduced as a plug-and-play advisor conceptualizing longitudinal therapy as evidence-grounded hypothesis adjudication. The approach encodes each clinical hypothesis as a mutable entry bound to corroborating and contradicting evidence. Across sessions, accumulating data strengthens supported entries, preserves provisional ones, and retracts contradicted assumptions. The resulting formulation distills into concise guidance for unmodified therapeutic language models. Experiments demonstrate substantial improvements in both conceptualization and intervention quality without requiring backbone retraining.

Abstract:Misinformation spreads faster than professional fact-checkers can manually verify it and write articles explaining their verdicts. Abstract:Legislative hearings are distinct communication events with their own human recognizable structure and logic, yet they have been analyzed as distinct phenomena beyond their transcripts. Understanding legislative hearings at a deeper level is a major step in analyzing the work and power relationships within democratic bodies. In this work, we present a novel end-to-end pipeline for parsing rhetorical structures from legislative committee hearings with the goal of improving legislative discourse analysis and democratic accountability. We also propose a rhetorical structure grammar and find that 55.21% of California state bill discussions in our dataset can be parsed with this grammar. We evaluate our pipeline with two utterance section classifiers on a random subset of over 2,000 annotated utterances corresponding to 100 hearings. We find that a logistic regression-based classifier with grammar-based output masking and utterance tag smoothing outperforms more complex models, achieving an F1 score of 52.8% against our ground truth discourse section labels.

Abstract:We investigate whether open-source LLMs encode a linearly separable truthfulness signal in their hidden states, and at which network depth this signal is strongest. Across three 7 B-- 8 B instruction-tuned models (Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B, Qwen2.5-7B) loaded in 4 -bit NF4 quantization, we extract per-layer hidden states on four hallucination benchmarks (TruthfulQA, HaluEval-QA, FEVER, and a controlled synthetic set) and compare four detection approaches: linear and MLP probes, INSIDE EigenScore, self-consistency, and attention entropy. A linear probe on a single mid-network layer achieves 0.904 – 1.000 AUROC on held-out splits, while sampling-based detectors do not exceed 0.541 AUROC under the same protocol. The truthfulness signal is approximately linear: MLP probes rarely surpass linear probes by more than 0.01 AUROC. Peak probing layers fall in a consistent band across model families on natural-language benchmarks – blocks~ 13 – 18 of~ 32 for Llama and Mistral, and blocks~ 19 – 25 of~ 28 for Qwen. First-block attention entropy provides a complementary signal in knowledge-grounded settings ( 0.866 – 0.941 AUROC on HaluEval-QA) at no additional inference cost. The low discriminability of sampling methods under this protocol reflects a structural mismatch between paired-label evaluation and the information these methods access, rather than an inherent limitation of those methods. Code and data are released for full reproducibility on a single 8 ,GB GPU.

[IR-0] Balancing hierarchical representation and quantization: A performance trade-off in text embeddings

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06859
作者: Kai Ponel,Marco Polignano,Erasmo Purificato,Aylin Julia Temizkan,Marco Levantesi,Giovanni Semeraro,Ernesto William De Luca

备注: 29 pages. Authors’ version of the open access article published in Information Sciences (CC BY 4.0). This version corrects the second affiliation of Marco Polignano (Otto von Guericke University Magdeburg); the published version lists the European Commission, Joint Research Centre (JRC) in error. Marco Polignano is not affiliated with the JRC. No other content has been changed

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Hierarchical text embedding models offer variable-length representations, while quantization reduces numerical precision; both aim to improve computational efficiency. This work is an empirical benchmark study of how these two orthogonal, already-established techniques interact. We evaluate 38 tasks from the Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB) using four transformer-based embedding models, covering 1D and 2D hierarchical representations combined with 32-bit, 8-bit, and binary quantization, for 168 configurations per task. We report each efficiency dimension separately: theoretical per-vector storage and end-to-end evaluation time. Under a Friedman test with Nemenyi post-hoc analysis, int8 quantization is statistically indistinguishable from float32 for pair classification and re-ranking and costs at most 1.5 percentage points overall, whereas binary quantization is significantly worse across every task category. Halving the embedding dimension once is not statistically detectable above m=16 ; two successive halvings always are. Combining an 8x dimensionality reduction with int8 yields a 32x reduction in per-vector storage at 94.4% of baseline effectiveness. Because evaluation times were measured once, we treat them as indicative: we find no evidence that quantization speeds up evaluation, whereas sampling from intermediate layers shortens it substantially. Retrieval degrades far faster than every other category, so we report findings per task category.

作者: Wenyi Xu,Renzhe Zhou,Songyang Li,Feiran Zhu,Ruoqi Zhao,Chenglei Dai,Xuanping Li,Kaiqiao Zhan,Jingwei Zhuo
类目: Information Retrieval (cs.IR)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Algorithm-driven services, including search, recommendation, and advertising, rely on multi-stage model pipelines. While research prioritizes model optimization, post-deployment monitoring focuses on operational reliability. Yet operationally healthy systems may still produce poor-quality results, exposing a gap in existing evaluation and monitoring practices. However, a systematic problem formulation and benchmark for this task remain lacking. To bridge this gap, we formulate System Quality Diagnosis (SQD) for algorithm-driven services, a new task that extends quality evaluation beyond identifying poor outcomes to attributing their causes across system components. Focusing on industrial search, we propose WISE, an agentic framework for end-to-end quality diagnosis that discovers user-facing issues and traces their origins to underlying algorithmic components. To improve diagnostic reliability, we introduce ReTrace for constructing evidence-consistent trajectory supervision and Adaptive Harness-Policy Optimization (AHPO) for failure-guided optimization of the agent harness and model policy. To enable systematic evaluation, we construct WISE-BENCH, a real-world multimodal search benchmark that combines user-facing evidence, internal pipeline traces, and expert diagnosis annotations. Extensive experiments show consistent gains across model scales, with WISE achieving 75.20% end-to-end accuracy on Qwen3.5-35B-A3B. In production, WISE supports quality auditing, online quality assurance, and model optimization, reducing diagnosis costs and improving downstream relevance models.

作者: Mario Mallea,Angela Nebot,Francisco Mugica
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Information Retrieval (cs.IR)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Collaborative filtering (CF) is a cornerstone of recommender systems and plays a relevant role in many modern applications. CF uses user-item interaction data to discover future preferences. Although deep learning models have shown promise in CF, Embarrassingly Shallow Autoencoders for Sparse Data (EASE) has gained attention for its outstanding ranking accuracy provided by its closed-form solution. EASE relies primarily on relationships among items to fit a full-rank high-dimensional linear mapping. We hypothesize that this design limits its capacity to capture similar but not equivalent fine-grained user relationships, consequently limiting its recommendation accuracy. This paper introduces an alternative formulation based on EASE that takes advantage of user-user information. Furthermore, we propose a hybrid model that combines both user-user and item-item adjacency distributions. Our experiments reveal that the proposed models outperform EASE on well-known recommendation benchmarks, highlighting the significance of including the user alternative in shallow autoencoder studies for CF. [IR-3] Deliberate Latent Reasoning for Sequential Recommendation

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06521
作者: Haobo Zhang,Qiannan Zhu,Yutao Zhu,Zhicheng Dou
类目: Information Retrieval (cs.IR)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Sequential recommenders are widely applied in real-world scenarios to model user preferences and behavior patterns based on user interactions. Recent advances in sequential recommendation enhance transformer-based models with latent reasoning to refine user representations by autoregressively generating intermediate reasoning vectors. However, exploring the optimal reasoning depth for diverse user histories remains challenging: existing methods typically employ a fixed number of reasoning steps for all users. This ``one-size-fits-all’’ strategy often leads to suboptimal representation learning due to over-thinking in simple histories or under-thinking in complex ones. To address this issue, we propose DESRec, a deliberate latent reasoning framework that performs personalized latent reasoning to learn more informative reasoning states and enhance user modeling for sequential recommendation. Specifically, it designs a reasoning step selection module that identifies the optimal reasoning step for each user sequence during the training phase. Through a self-distillation mechanism, it compresses this most informative state into the final reasoning step, which serves as the final user representation for item ranking during inference. Moreover, it introduces a progressive preference extraction mechanism for personalized reasoning, which dynamically segments a user’s history into a variable number of periods and summarizes each into a latent milestone representing the user’s preference for that period. It will be used as the input of the subsequent reasoning. The number of milestones varies with the users’ history, enabling a personalized reasoning over users’ evolving interests. Extensive experimental results on six public datasets and four backbone recommenders demonstrate the superiority of DESRec over eight baseline models.

[IR-4] Signed but Steerable: Measuring and Closing the Text-Vector Integrity Gap in Offline Retrieval-Augmented Generation

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06498
作者: Georgios Feretzakis,Alexandros Papaspyridis
类目: Cryptography and Security (cs.CR); Information Retrieval (cs.IR); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 20 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. Code and data: this https URL (DOI https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23948839 )

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Offline retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) on edge devices is updated through signed knowledge packs that carry text and precomputed embedding vectors. A signature proves who published a pack, not that its vectors encode its text. We study this text-vector integrity gap. A verifier that recomputes vectors and accepts them within a cosine tolerance concedes a predictable share of queries to an attacker who controls the vectors: the hijack rate equals the distribution of angular retrieval margins at the tolerance (the margin law). Margins are small in five corpora and two embedding models, so an idealised tolerance at the level of floating-point noise leaves up to 5.5% of queries exposed (at most 1.2% in any corpus once exact duplicate documents are excluded), and a threshold calibrated from our CPU INT8-FP32 comparison of a small embedding model (at the empirical 0.1% quantile of honest cosines) leaves 98-100% exposed; on a Raspberry Pi 5 running a local language model, such an attack lowers correct answers from 0.75 to 0.39. Integrity audits of compressed vector stores fare no better: on a FAISS product-quantisation index over 57,638 documents, tampered vectors that all pass the audit put the attacker’s document first for 25% of targets. Verifying quantisation codes instead, with ambiguity decided by the verifier, a calibrated guard band and canonicalisation, accepted every honest vector in our samples on three platforms and left the publisher no choice. We also show that common floating-point and dynamic-INT8 inference pipelines are not bit-reproducible across batch sizes or architectures, and report pre-registered negative results on abstention, context pruning and semantic screening. We release code and data.

Abstract:Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) answers questions by retrieving over a knowledge graph built from a corpus. Yet retrieval strategies are designed around the structure their own construction pipeline produces, and whether they survive a change of construction is rarely tested. We study this cross-construction portability: whether one retrieval procedure, with no construction-specific schema, relation names, or retuning, stays effective when the graph is built differently. We introduce ArcRAG, which induces a query-local graph interface at inference time (the node labels, relation descriptors, and property keys reachable from the entities a question names), plans multi-hop traversals against it, and executes and repairs them as Cypher. We build each of the MuSiQue, HotpotQA, and TriviaQA corpora as a schema-guided graph (typed nodes, a closed relation set, source provenance) and as an open-information-extraction graph (untyped nodes, free-text relations), with the retriever’s configuration fixed across them. We compare against a construction-agnostic Direct-Cypher agent, ablate each stage across retry and pass budgets on both graph families, and compare with results reported for prior GraphRAG systems, most of which design retrieval together with their own graph construction. Across the two constructions, we find that retrieval need not be co-designed with the graph: query-time interface induction keeps a construction-agnostic retriever effective when the construction changes, although construction still shapes absolute accuracy.

点击查看摘要

Abstract:On Web platforms for shopping and entertainment, recommendation agents under multimodal queries aim to deliver personalized recommendations that satisfy users’ visually specified requirements and reflect preferences inferred from user histories. However, existing personalized recommendation benchmarks use text-only queries, while multimodal ones assess query matching without evaluating personalization based on real user histories. We introduce the Personalized Multimodal Recommendation Benchmark (PMRecBench), the first benchmark to evaluate the personalization of recommendation agents under multimodal queries. It pairs 510 quality-controlled image-text queries across clothing and movies with the corresponding users’ real histories. PMRecBench features two key designs: (1) queries derived from consistent behavioral patterns in real user records, with reference images and targets linked to actual interactions; and (2) challenging diagnostic pools with candidate items rated highly by the user but violating requirements, and items satisfying requirements but never rated highly, testing requirement understanding and preference following, respectively. Extensive experiments on diagnostic pools reveal a personalization imbalance in recommendation agents: relative to personalization signals alone, adding multimodal queries weakens preference following, even though the additional information about query requirements improves overall ranking performance. Further analysis links this decline in preference following to image interpretation, where agents can prioritize resemblance to reference images over evidence from user histories, and stronger commercial backbones alone fail to resolve this imbalance. This personalization imbalance highlights a central challenge for recommendation agents: improving ranking performance while preserving preference following when responding to multimodal user queries

Abstract:Generative retrieval predicts semantic identifiers for candidate entities. In local retail and food delivery, candidates must also be serviceable for a particular user at a particular time. Location, weather, and traffic reshape merchant and product supply, so a catalog-valid identifier may be infeasible for the current request. Post-generation filtering removes such candidates only after beam capacity and inference computation have been spent. We study retrieval over an explicitly materialized, request-time supply snapshot, where short output sequences leave little opportunity to amortize online constraint preparation. Our RTP-LLM pipeline compiles eligible residual-quantization identifiers into a compressed sparse row prefix index, overlaps CPU compilation with model prefill, and shares the uploaded index across beams. Legal expansions retain original-model log probabilities, and constraint states follow selected beam parents. We formalize snapshot-relative identifier validity and distinguish it from entity-level eligibility and freshness. The implementation generates three-token merchant identifiers. Historical evidence covers daily catalog constraints and subsequent request-scoped serving evaluations. In one matched-beam daily-constraint case, filtered merchants decrease from 170 of 299 candidates to 29 of 299; residual distance filtering motivates request-specific constraints. A different-host comparison with 30,000 supplied entries reports a 0.6 ms service-side latency increment, while client measurements expose additional request costs. Captured requests from three geographic settings characterize behavior across supply sizes and output widths. These observations span development stages and measurement boundaries. They establish a practical implementation and identify bottlenecks, but do not establish compute savings at matched retrieval quality.

Abstract:Search-augmented recommenders can use the latest search episode and earlier searches. We introduce FocalSwap to test how these inputs contribute to the next recommendation. On the same 66,139 rows, replacing all search inputs with a neutral ID yields a positive signed contribution, whereas replacing them with category/profile-matched observed search sequences gives smaller estimates, with an interval below zero for one checkpoint. The paired RR gaps range from +2.770 \times 10^-3 to +6.604 \times 10^-3 , and every adjusted interval is above zero. Neutral masks change 59.7-61.7% of target ranks, while matched replacements change 44.1-44.8%. The control contrast persists across five alternative donor assignments per checkpoint. These results show why masking evidence should be compared with observed-search replacements when attributing a benefit to broader search state or the latest episode. Comments: Accepted at WSDM 2027. Abstract:Helping users discover new interests is vital to the long-term health of industrial recommender systems, yet the usual remedy, boosting exposure of under-explored (discovery) content, often backfires in production. We report URED (Unexposed Recycling for Efficient Discovery), a training-free recall-stage system serving Taobao feed recommendation at Alibaba for over six months to tens of millions of daily active users. It rests on a production-validated insight: naive boosting fails because it injects cold, information-poor candidates that rankers systematically over-estimate, buying no discovery gain while risking engagement. Items scored highly but never exposed (signals industrial pipelines routinely discard) form a pool that is both relevant and reliably predictable. Over a 30-day horizon URED aggregates them and re-injects at recall time through a lightweight pipeline spanning offline storage, distributed aggregation, and low-latency online serving, adding under 1% latency via a single O(1) lookup per request with no model retraining. Online A/B tests show +3.47% discovered categories and +8.47% content richness with engagement preserved: completion video views rise significantly (+2.62%) and total views move positive (+0.36%, not significant). Abstract:Financial asset recommendation for retail investors is typically optimized for relevance, that is, how well a recommendation matches what each user will buy. From the service provider’s point of view, the value of a recommendation also depends on portfolio performance: the risk-adjusted return the recommended assets (the basket) deliver, which drives user engagement and fee revenue. The two goals are rarely achieved jointly, because the recommendations that best match user behavior concentrate on a few popular assets whose returns are highly correlated, which caps the risk-adjusted return a provider can offer. We propose Decorrelated-Satellite Expert Re-ranking (\textbfDSER), which retains the most relevant recommendations from an expert-following list and replaces the rest with return-decorrelated alternatives. The number of replaced slots is a single integer~ m (a knob) that the provider sets, so the relevance–performance trade-off becomes an explicit, auditable choice rather than a property hidden inside a learned model. In experiments on the public FAR-Trans retail-brokerage dataset, under the primary protocol, replacing a few slots improves risk-adjusted return at a small relevance cost, and the gain survives realistic trading costs at typical retail portfolio sizes. Minimizing correlation would lower basket volatility, but in our data the least-correlated assets are more volatile and higher-return, so their volatility offsets that reduction while their return drives the gain, not lower volatility. The resulting trade-off is asymmetric, with the relevance cost consistent across market phases while the gain is phase-dependent. The provider sets m to read off exactly how much relevance each operating point costs.

Abstract:Second-stage neural rankers are commonly applied with a fixed re-ranking depth, assuming that retrieval effectiveness saturates as depth increases. With the advent of LLM-based relevance judgments we can now more easily undertake such studies, in this case to pinpoint the optimal re-ranking depth on a per-query basis. Through a large-scale analysis, we find that most standard query performance prediction (QPP) methods are ineffective for this task. In contrast, a predictor derived from LLM-assessed first-stage ranking quality, which we term IR-DCG@10, can reduce the average re-ranking depth by up to a factor of 3 while preserving overall effectiveness, depending on the specific first- and second-stage rankers used. Abstract:Personalized retrieval-augmented generation requires extracting and applying user preferences from extended interaction histories. This task is challenging because preference evidence is scattered across past conversations and remains bound to specific temporal and situational contexts. Consequently, isolated fragments rarely provide complete support for a response, while preferences expressed under different conditions are easily conflated. To address these limitations, we propose Weaver, a framework that incrementally weaves memory-conditioned retrieval trajectories with compositional preference reasoning for personalized responses. Weaver operates on a Dual-Layer Retrieval and Reasoning Graph that couples an upper Intent Dependency Graph with a lower Memory-Conditioned Retrieval Trajectory Graph. Dependency Information Gap Tracking represents the information needed to answer the current request and its prerequisite dependencies in the upper graph. Memory-Conditioned Incremental Retrieval uses established premises and clues from retrieved conversations to locate missing evidence, recording the resulting retrieval trajectories in the lower graph. Scope-Aware Compositional Reasoning jointly interprets the accumulated evidence to determine which preferences apply to the request. It identifies complementary and alternative support and distinguishes conflicting claims within the same temporal and situational context. These conclusions iteratively update task premises and remaining information gaps, guiding subsequent retrieval to establish a coherent contextual basis for the final response. Experiments on personalized RAG benchmarks, particularly PersonaMem, demonstrate that Weaver outperforms leading baselines in both evidence completeness and answer quality.

Abstract:Researchers frequently encounter difficulties re-finding scientific papers when they remember aspects of the content but cannot recall reliable identifiers, such as titles or author names. Abstract:Modern recommender systems rely on generative retrieval techniques to predict the next item either as discrete codes or as a continuous vector. Abstract:Graph-based Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search (ANNS) indexes such as HNSW and Vamana deliver state-of-the-art query performance at the cost of large indexing times. We also extend PiPNN II and GPiPNN to compute high-quality k -NN graphs directly, which unlocks massive speedups over methods used in many existing systems for clustering, anomaly detection, and more.
